This Independent Contractor Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of , 2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between:
AtliQ Inc, a Delaware corporation (EIN 88-4410273) with its principal place of business at 101 College Road East, Suite 210, Princeton, New Jersey 08540 (the "Company"); and
Daniel Ortiz, an individual residing at 4718 Avenue F, Austin, Texas 78751 (the "Contractor").
The Company and the Contractor are each a "Party" and together the "Parties."

clauses.title: Services
clauses.text: The Contractor shall provide the services described in the Engagement Schedule (the "Services"). Additional services may be added by a written Engagement Schedule signed by both Parties.

clauses.title: Services
clauses.text: The Contractor shall perform the Services in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with generally accepted industry standards, and shall comply with the Company's reasonable instructions regarding deliverables and timelines.

clauses.title: Services
clauses.text: The Contractor determines the manner, means and hours of performing the Services, subject to reasonable coordination with the Company's project team.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues for the term stated in the Engagement Schedule, unless terminated earlier under this Section 2.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason on fourteen (14) days' written notice to the other Party.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Either Party may terminate this Agreement immediately on written notice if the other Party materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure the breach within ten (10) days after receiving written notice of it.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: On termination, the Company shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed through the effective date of termination, and the Contractor shall deliver to the Company all work product completed or in progress.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: The Company shall pay the Contractor at the hourly rate stated in the Engagement Schedule.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: The Contractor shall submit a monthly invoice with a summary of hours worked. The Company shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt, by ACH transfer in U.S. Dollars.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: If the Company disputes any portion of an invoice in good faith, it shall notify the Contractor within ten (10) days of receipt and pay the undisputed portion on time.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: Pre-approved, reasonable out-of-pocket expenses shall be reimbursed at cost against receipts.

clauses.title: Independent contractor status
clauses.text: The Contractor is an independent contractor and not an employee, partner or agent of the Company. The Contractor is not eligible for any Company employee benefits.

clauses.title: Independent contractor status
clauses.text: The Contractor is solely responsible for all taxes on amounts paid under this Agreement. The Contractor shall provide a completed IRS Form W-9, and the Company shall issue IRS Form 1099-NEC as required.

clauses.title: Independent contractor status
clauses.text: The Contractor may provide services to other clients during the term, provided that doing so does not interfere with the Services or breach Section 7.

clauses.title: Equipment and tools
clauses.text: The Contractor shall furnish, at the Contractor's own expense, the computer equipment, software, internet connectivity and other tools the Contractor considers necessary to perform the Services, and shall be responsible for maintaining them.

clauses.title: Equipment and tools
clauses.text: The Company shall provide the Contractor with user accounts and access credentials to the Company's project repositories and communication tools as needed for the Services. The Contractor shall not share those credentials with any other person.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: All work product, code, scripts, data pipelines, documentation and other materials created by the Contractor in performing the Services (the "Work Product") are works made for hire for the Company to the extent permitted by law. To the extent any Work Product is not a work made for hire, the Contractor hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest in it, including all intellectual property rights, effective upon payment for the Services to which it relates.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: The Contractor retains ownership of general skills, know-how and tools developed before the Effective Date and not specific to the Company or its clients ("Contractor Tools"). If any Contractor Tools are incorporated into Work Product, the Contractor grants the Company and its clients a perpetual, royalty-free, non-exclusive, transferable license to use them as part of the Work Product.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: The Contractor shall execute any documents reasonably required to perfect the Company's rights under this Section 6, at the Company's expense.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each Party shall keep confidential the non-public business, technical and financial information of the other Party, and of the Company's clients, disclosed to it in connection with this Agreement, and shall use it only for the purposes of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: The obligations in Section 7.1 do not apply to information that is publicly available, already known to the receiving Party, lawfully received from a third party, or independently developed.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: The Parties have entered into, or will enter into, a Mutual Nondisclosure Agreement, which shall also apply. On termination, the Contractor shall return or delete Company and client information in the Contractor's possession.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: This Section 7 survives termination for three (3) years.

clauses.title: Non-solicitation
clauses.text: During the term and for six (6) months after it, neither Party shall knowingly solicit for employment any employee of the other Party with whom it worked in connection with the Services. General advertisements not targeted at such persons are not a breach. Nothing in this Agreement restricts the Contractor from working for any client or competitor of the Company after the term.

clauses.title: Warranties and liability
clauses.text: The Contractor warrants that the Work Product will be original to the Contractor (except for Contractor Tools and open-source components disclosed to the Company) and will not knowingly infringe any third party's intellectual property rights.

clauses.title: Warranties and liability
clauses.text: Each Party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable to the Contractor under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, except for breach of Section 7 or a Party's fraud or willful misconduct.

clauses.title: Warranties and liability
clauses.text: Neither Party shall be liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages.

clauses.title: General - Governing Law; Venue
clauses.text: Governing Law; Venue. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Texas, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. The Parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Travis County, Texas.

clauses.title: General - Assignment
clauses.text: Assignment. The Contractor may not assign or subcontract this Agreement without the Company's prior written consent. The Company may assign this Agreement to an Affiliate or successor on written notice.

clauses.title: General - Notices
clauses.text: Notices. Notices shall be given in writing by email with confirmation of receipt, or by courier, to the addresses above (for the Company, Attn: President).

clauses.title: General - Entire Agreement
clauses.text: Entire Agreement. This Agreement, including the Engagement Schedule, is the entire agreement of the Parties on its subject matter and may be amended only in writing signed by both Parties.

clauses.title: General - Counterparts
clauses.text: Counterparts. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature.

clauses.text:
*(AtliQ draft prepared by Pranav on 2026-09-26 from the vendor template. Not yet sent to vendor.)*
AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd — Agreement No. ATQ-VSA-2026-011
Form: AtliQ Vendor Services Agreement (Rev. 09/2026)
This Subcontractor Services Agreement (together with the Engagement Schedule and any amendments hereto, this "Agreement") is entered into as of the date of the last signature below (the "Effective Date") by and between AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, a private limited company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456, GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3, having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("AtliQ"), and Kriti Data Labs LLP, a limited liability partnership registered under the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008, having its office at Office No. 7, 2nd Floor, Shreeji Heights, Kothrud, Pune 411038, Maharashtra, India ("Vendor"). AtliQ and Vendor are each a "Party" and collectively the "Parties."

clauses.title: Recitals
Definitions
clauses.text: "AtliQ Materials" means all data, datasets, information, systems access, documents and other materials furnished by or on behalf of AtliQ or the End Client.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Deliverables" means all labelled datasets, annotations, label files, quality reports, documentation and other materials prepared or delivered by or on behalf of Vendor under this Agreement, in whole or in part.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Delivery Date" means each date for delivery of a Deliverable set forth in the Engagement Schedule.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "End Client" means the client of AtliQ identified in the Engagement Schedule for whose project the Services are performed.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Fees" means the amounts payable to Vendor as set forth in the Engagement Schedule.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Losses" means any and all losses, damages, liabilities, deficiencies, claims, actions, judgments, settlements, interest, awards, penalties, fines, costs or expenses of whatever kind, including reasonable legal fees.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Services" means the services described in Article 2 and in the Engagement Schedule.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Total Fees" means the aggregate Fees payable under this Agreement as stated in the Engagement Schedule.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Vendor Personnel" means all partners, employees, agents and contractors of Vendor who perform any portion of the Services.

clauses.title: Services - Scope
clauses.text: Scope. Vendor shall perform the Services described in the Engagement Schedule.

clauses.title: Services - Standards of Performance
clauses.text: Standards of Performance. Vendor shall perform the Services in a diligent, professional and workmanlike manner, in accordance with the highest standards of the industry, and in compliance with AtliQ's annotation guidelines and quality requirements made available to Vendor, as updated from time to time.

clauses.title: Services - Vendor Personnel
clauses.text: Vendor Personnel. Vendor shall assign qualified Vendor Personnel. AtliQ may, in its sole discretion, request removal of any Vendor Personnel, and Vendor shall promptly replace such individual at no additional cost to AtliQ.

clauses.title: Services - Subcontracting
clauses.text: Subcontracting. Vendor shall not subcontract any portion of the Services without AtliQ's prior written consent. Vendor shall remain fully responsible for any subcontractor's performance.

clauses.title: Services - Change Orders
clauses.text: Change Orders. No change in the scope of Services shall be binding unless set forth in a written change order executed by authorized representatives of both Parties.

clauses.title: Acceptance
clauses.text: AtliQ shall have fifteen (15) days following delivery of each Deliverable to test and evaluate such Deliverable against the acceptance criteria in the Engagement Schedule, including where AtliQ so elects, review by the End Client.

clauses.title: Acceptance
clauses.text: If AtliQ determines that a Deliverable does not conform, Vendor shall correct the non-conformity at no cost within five (5) business days. AtliQ may repeat the acceptance process until the Deliverable conforms, or may, at its option, reject the Deliverable and receive a refund of all Fees paid in respect thereof.

clauses.title: Acceptance
clauses.text: Acceptance shall not be deemed to occur by use, by delivery to the End Client, by payment, or by the passage of time.

clauses.title: Fees, invoicing and payment - Fees
clauses.text: Fees. AtliQ shall pay Vendor the Fees set forth in the Engagement Schedule. Fees are firm and fixed and shall not be increased during the term of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Fees, invoicing and payment - Invoices
clauses.text: Invoices. Vendor shall invoice AtliQ monthly in arrears for Deliverables accepted in the preceding month. Each invoice shall be a valid tax invoice under the CGST Act, 2017, state Vendor's GSTIN and PAN, and reference the Agreement No.

clauses.title: Fees, invoicing and payment - Payment Terms
clauses.text: Payment Terms. AtliQ's obligation to pay any invoice is conditional upon AtliQ's receipt of payment from the End Client for the corresponding services. AtliQ shall pay each properly submitted, undisputed invoice within fifteen (15) days after AtliQ receives the corresponding payment from the End Client, and in any event not later than one hundred and twenty (120) days after AtliQ's receipt of the invoice.

clauses.title: Fees, invoicing and payment - Disputed Amounts
clauses.text: Disputed Amounts. AtliQ may withhold payment of any amount it disputes in good faith. Vendor shall continue performing the Services during the pendency of any dispute.

clauses.title: Fees, invoicing and payment - Set-off
clauses.text: Set-off. AtliQ may set off against any amount owed to Vendor any amount owed by Vendor to AtliQ under this Agreement, including liquidated damages.

clauses.title: Fees, invoicing and payment - Taxes
clauses.text: Taxes. GST shall be payable in addition to the Fees against a valid tax invoice. AtliQ shall deduct tax at source as required under the Income-tax Act, 1961 and furnish the applicable TDS certificate.

clauses.title: Term and termination - Term
clauses.text: Term. This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue until completion of the Services, unless earlier terminated as provided herein.

clauses.title: Term and termination - Termination for Cause
clauses.text: Termination for Cause. Either Party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice if the other Party materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure such breach within fifteen (15) days after written notice thereof.

clauses.title: Term and termination - Termination for Convenience
clauses.text: Termination for Convenience. AtliQ may terminate this Agreement, in whole or in part, for any reason or no reason, upon seven (7) days' written notice to Vendor. Upon such termination, AtliQ's sole obligation shall be to pay Fees for Deliverables accepted by AtliQ prior to the effective date of termination; AtliQ shall have no obligation to pay for work in progress, unaccepted Deliverables, demobilization costs or anticipated profits.

clauses.title: Term and termination - Effect of Termination
clauses.text: Effect of Termination. Upon expiration or termination, Vendor shall immediately deliver to AtliQ all Deliverables, whether complete or incomplete, and return or delete all AtliQ Materials.

clauses.title: Term and termination - Survival
clauses.text: Survival. Articles 6, 7, 9, 10, 11 and 12 shall survive expiration or termination.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: "Confidential Information" means all non-public information disclosed by or on behalf of AtliQ or the End Client, including AtliQ Materials, business plans, technical information and pricing.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Vendor shall (a) hold Confidential Information in strict confidence, (b) use it only to perform the Services, and (c) disclose it only to those Vendor Personnel with a need to know who are bound by written obligations at least as protective.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: The foregoing obligations shall not apply to information that (a) is or becomes publicly available through no fault of Vendor; (b) was rightfully known without restriction prior to disclosure; (c) is rightfully received from a third party without restriction; or (d) is independently developed without use of Confidential Information.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Vendor acknowledges that any breach of this Article may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages would be inadequate, and that AtliQ shall be entitled to injunctive relief.

clauses.title: Intellectual property - AtliQ Materials
clauses.text: AtliQ Materials. All AtliQ Materials are and shall remain the sole property of AtliQ or the End Client, as applicable. Nothing in this Agreement grants Vendor any right in AtliQ Materials except the limited right to use them to perform the Services.

clauses.title: Intellectual property - Vendor IP
clauses.text: Vendor IP. Vendor shall retain all right, title and interest in and to its tools, labelling platform, scripts, ontologies, annotation guidelines developed by Vendor, and annotation outputs, including all intellectual property rights therein (collectively, "Vendor IP").

clauses.title: Intellectual property - Licence to AtliQ
clauses.text: Licence to AtliQ. Subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Vendor grants AtliQ a non-exclusive, non-transferable, perpetual licence to use the annotation outputs and Deliverables for the purposes of the End Client project, including delivery to the End Client.

clauses.title: Intellectual property - Moral Rights
clauses.text: Moral Rights. To the extent permitted by law, Vendor waives, and shall cause Vendor Personnel to waive, all moral rights in the Deliverables.

clauses.title: Representations and warranties
clauses.text: Each Party represents and warrants that it is duly organized, validly existing and has full power and authority to enter into and perform this Agreement.

clauses.title: Representations and warranties
clauses.text: Vendor further represents and warrants that: (a) the Services shall be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner; (b) the Deliverables shall meet the accuracy thresholds in the Engagement Schedule; (c) the Deliverables shall not infringe any third-party intellectual property right; and (d) Vendor shall comply with all applicable laws.

clauses.title: Indemnification - By Vendor
clauses.text: By Vendor. Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless AtliQ, its Affiliates, and their respective directors, officers, employees, agents, successors and assigns (the "AtliQ Indemnitees") from and against any and all Losses arising out of or relating to (a) the Services or Deliverables, (b) any breach of this Agreement by Vendor, (c) any claim by the End Client relating to the Services or Deliverables, or (d) any act or omission of Vendor Personnel, in each case regardless of whether such Losses are caused in whole or in part by the negligence of any AtliQ Indemnitee.

clauses.title: Indemnification - Procedure
clauses.text: Procedure. AtliQ shall give prompt written notice of any claim. AtliQ shall have the right to participate with counsel of its choice at Vendor's expense. Vendor shall not settle any claim without AtliQ's prior written consent.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability - Exclusion of Consequential Damages
clauses.text: Exclusion of Consequential Damages. IN NO EVENT SHALL ATLIQ BE LIABLE TO VENDOR FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, OR FOR LOST PROFITS, ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability - Cap on AtliQ Liability
clauses.text: Cap on AtliQ Liability. ATLIQ'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES ACTUALLY PAID BY ATLIQ TO VENDOR UNDER THIS AGREEMENT.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability - Vendor Liability
clauses.text: Vendor Liability. NOTHING IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL LIMIT OR EXCLUDE VENDOR'S LIABILITY FOR ANY LOSSES, WHETHER DIRECT OR INDIRECT, ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT, INCLUDING VENDOR'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS.

clauses.title: Delay; liquidated damages - Time of the Essence
clauses.text: Time of the Essence. Time is of the essence with respect to each Delivery Date.

clauses.title: Delay; liquidated damages - Liquidated Damages
clauses.text: Liquidated Damages. If Vendor fails to achieve any Delivery Date, Vendor shall pay AtliQ, as liquidated damages, an amount equal to two percent (2%) of the Total Fees for each calendar day from the Delivery Date until the date the applicable Deliverable is accepted.

clauses.title: Delay; liquidated damages - Cumulative Remedies
clauses.text: Cumulative Remedies. Liquidated damages under this Article are in addition to and not in lieu of AtliQ's right to recover its actual damages, to terminate this Agreement for cause, and to exercise any other right or remedy available at law or in equity. AtliQ may deduct liquidated damages from any amounts otherwise due to Vendor.

clauses.title: Governing law and dispute resolution - Governing Law
clauses.text: Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India.

clauses.title: Governing law and dispute resolution - Escalation
clauses.text: Escalation. The Parties shall attempt in good faith to resolve any dispute through escalation to their respective senior management for a period of fifteen (15) days.

clauses.title: Governing law and dispute resolution - Jurisdiction
clauses.text: Jurisdiction. Subject to Section 12.2, the courts at Pune, Maharashtra shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement.

clauses.title: General provisions - Independent Contractor
clauses.text: Independent Contractor. Vendor is an independent contractor. Nothing herein creates an employment, partnership, joint venture or agency relationship. Vendor shall be solely responsible for the salaries, statutory contributions and other entitlements of Vendor Personnel.

clauses.title: General provisions - Assignment
clauses.text: Assignment. Vendor may not assign this Agreement without AtliQ's prior written consent. AtliQ may assign this Agreement to any Affiliate or successor without consent.

clauses.title: General provisions - Non-Exclusivity
clauses.text: Non-Exclusivity. This Agreement is non-exclusive. AtliQ may engage other vendors for similar services.

clauses.title: General provisions - Publicity
clauses.text: Publicity. Vendor shall not use the name, logo or trademarks of AtliQ or the End Client without AtliQ's prior written consent.

clauses.title: General provisions - Notices
clauses.text: Notices. Notices shall be in writing and delivered by hand, courier or email to the addresses above: if to AtliQ, Attn: Pranav, CTO (pranav@atliq.com); if to Vendor, Attn: Kriti Deshpande, Founder.

clauses.title: General provisions - Severability; Waiver
clauses.text: Severability; Waiver. If any provision is held invalid, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force. No waiver shall be effective unless in writing.

clauses.title: General provisions - Entire Agreement
clauses.text: Entire Agreement. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement of the Parties with respect to its subject matter and supersedes all prior agreements. Vendor's quotes, invoices or standard terms shall have no effect.

clauses.title: General provisions - Counterparts; Electronic Signatures
clauses.text: Counterparts; Electronic Signatures. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature.

clauses.title: Engagement schedule
clauses.text:
End Client: Rheinwerk Analytics GmbH, Munich, Germany (AtliQ project: Rheinwerk Insight data pipeline modernisation, Contract No. RWA-2026-014).
Services: Cleansing, labelling and annotation of machine-sensor time-series data and maintenance records exported from the End Client's Rheinwerk Insight platform, to populate the cleansed and curated data layers and data quality framework of the End Client project (Milestone M3), including training and validation datasets for the End Client's predictive-maintenance models. Source data comprises vibration, temperature and pressure sensor streams from End Client customer plants, together with maintenance work orders and technician logs (including technician names, shift identifiers and free-text notes). Vendor Personnel shall access data via AtliQ-provisioned cloud workspaces and Vendor's own labelling platform.
| # | Deliverable | Delivery Date | Fee (INR) |
| 1 | Label taxonomy and pilot batch (5,000 sensor windows) | Start + 2 weeks | 1,40,000 |
| 2 | Batch 1 — failure-event labelling (40,000 windows) | Start + 6 weeks | 3,20,000 |
| 3 | Batch 2 — maintenance-log classification (25,000 work orders) | Start + 10 weeks | 2,60,000 |
| 4 | Final QA pass and consolidated dataset | Start + 12 weeks | 1,20,000 |
| | Total Fees | | 8,40,000 |
Planned start: 2026-10-05. Accuracy threshold: 97% on AtliQ-sampled QA. GST extra as applicable.

clauses.title: Definitions

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Confidential Information" means all information, in any form, disclosed or made available by or on behalf of the Company to the Recipient or its Representatives, whether before or after the Effective Date, including customer and portfolio data, credit models, product plans, pricing, technology architecture, business processes, and all analyses, compilations, notes or other documents prepared by the Recipient that contain or reflect such information.

clauses.title: Use and protection of confidential information

clauses.text: The Recipient shall not, without the Company's prior written consent, disclose to any person the fact that discussions are taking place or any of their terms.

clauses.text:
The obligations in Clause 2 shall not apply to information which the Recipient can demonstrate by contemporaneous written evidence:
(a) is or becomes generally available to the public other than through a breach by the Recipient or its Representatives;
(b) was in the lawful possession of the Recipient prior to disclosure, free of any obligation of confidence; or
(c) is lawfully received by the Recipient from a third party not under any obligation of confidence to the Company.

clauses.title: Regulatory matters

clauses.title: Duration

clauses.title: Duration

clauses.title: No representation; no obligation

clauses.title: Remedies

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to its subject matter.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: No amendment or waiver shall be effective unless in writing and signed by authorised signatories of both Parties.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: The Recipient may not assign this Agreement. The Company may assign it to any Affiliate.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India, and the courts at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

clauses.text: This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature.

clauses.title: Preamble
clauses.text:
*(Partner draft received 2026-09-24 via Bhavin's email. Datavane's paper — AtliQ has not yet marked up.)*
Datavane, Inc. — Global Partner Program
Agreement No. DV-GPP-2026-0417 | Form: Datavane SPA (Implementation & Referral Partner) v4.2
This Strategic Partnership Agreement (together with its Schedules, this "Agreement") is entered into as of the date of the last signature below (the "Effective Date") by and between:
Datavane, Inc., a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business at 575 Market Street, Suite 2200, San Francisco, California 94105, USA ("Datavane"); and
AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, a private limited company incorporated under the laws of India, CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456, having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("Partner").
Datavane and Partner are each a "Party" and together the "Parties."

clauses.title: Recitals
clauses.text:
A. Datavane develops and offers the Datavane Lakehouse Platform, a cloud-native lakehouse and unified analytics platform offered on a subscription basis.
B. Partner provides data engineering, analytics, AI/ML and business intelligence services to enterprise customers.
C. Datavane wishes to appoint Partner as a non-exclusive implementation and referral partner for the Datavane Platform in the Territory, and Partner wishes to accept such appointment, on the terms of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Affiliate" means any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a Party, where "control" means ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting interests of an entity.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Datavane Platform" or "Platform" means Datavane's lakehouse, data warehouse, streaming, governance and analytics software offered as a service, including all updates, modules and add-ons made generally available by Datavane.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Customer" means any person or entity that purchases or evaluates a subscription to the Platform.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Prospect" means any person or entity that Partner identifies, introduces, registers or refers to Datavane, or with which Partner engages in any discussion regarding the Platform, whether or not such person or entity was an existing client of Partner prior to the Effective Date.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Datavane Account" means (a) each Customer, (b) each Prospect registered by Partner through the Partner Portal, and (c) each Prospect introduced to Datavane by Partner in any manner, together with such entity's Affiliates.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Joint Deal" means any transaction under which a Datavane Account purchases a Platform subscription together with implementation, migration, managed or consulting services delivered in whole or in part by Partner.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Joint Deal Revenue" means all amounts invoiced to a Datavane Account in respect of a Joint Deal, including Platform subscription fees and Partner Services fees, net of taxes.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Partner Services" means implementation, migration, integration, managed and consulting services relating to the Platform performed by Partner for Datavane Accounts.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Partner Portal" means Datavane's online partner relationship management system.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Territory" means the Republic of India; the member states of the Gulf Cooperation Council (United Arab Emirates, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, State of Qatar, State of Kuwait, Kingdom of Bahrain and Sultanate of Oman); and Europe (the member states of the European Union and the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland).

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Marks" means a Party's trademarks, trade names, service marks and logos.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Losses" means any and all losses, damages, liabilities, deficiencies, claims, actions, judgments, settlements, interest, awards, penalties, fines, costs or expenses of whatever kind, including reasonable attorneys' fees.

clauses.title: Appointment - Appointment
clauses.text: Appointment. Subject to the terms of this Agreement, Datavane appoints Partner, and Partner accepts appointment, as a non-exclusive "Datavane Premier Implementation Partner" for the Territory.

clauses.title: Appointment - Scope of Activities
clauses.text: Scope of Activities. Partner shall (a) actively promote the Platform to Prospects in the Territory; (b) register all Prospects in the Partner Portal within five (5) business days of first substantive contact; (c) deliver Partner Services to Datavane Accounts in accordance with Datavane's published implementation methodology; and (d) participate in joint marketing activities as agreed in the annual joint business plan.

clauses.title: Appointment - Non-Exclusivity
clauses.text: Non-Exclusivity. Datavane may appoint other partners, resellers and service providers in the Territory and may sell directly to any Customer or Prospect, including Prospects registered by Partner.

clauses.title: Appointment - Affiliates
clauses.text: Affiliates. Partner may perform Partner Services through its Affiliates, provided that Partner shall remain responsible for each Affiliate's compliance with this Agreement, and all obligations of Partner hereunder shall bind Partner's Affiliates.

clauses.title: Appointment - Deal Registration
clauses.text: Deal Registration. A Prospect registration is valid for ninety (90) days. Datavane may accept or reject any registration in its sole discretion. Acceptance of a registration does not guarantee that Partner will be engaged for any Joint Deal.

clauses.title: Partner obligations - Certified Personnel
clauses.text: Certified Personnel. Partner shall maintain at least six (6) Datavane Certified Engineers and one (1) Datavane Certified Architect throughout the Term, and shall ensure that all Partner Services are led by a Datavane Certified Architect.

clauses.title: Partner obligations - Pipeline Commitment
clauses.text: Pipeline Commitment. Partner shall use commercially reasonable efforts to register not fewer than twelve (12) qualified Prospects in each contract year.

clauses.title: Partner obligations - Conduct
clauses.text: Conduct. Partner shall not make any representation, warranty or commitment regarding the Platform other than as set out in Datavane's then-current published documentation.

clauses.title: Partner obligations - Compliance
clauses.text: Compliance. Partner shall comply with Datavane's Partner Code of Conduct, applicable anti-corruption laws (including the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act and the UK Bribery Act 2010) and applicable export control and sanctions laws.

clauses.title: Partner obligations - Reporting
clauses.text: Reporting. Partner shall provide Datavane with a monthly pipeline report and a quarterly business review in the format reasonably specified by Datavane.

clauses.title: Datavane obligations
clauses.text: Datavane shall provide Partner with (a) access to the Partner Portal; (b) up to ten (10) free certification vouchers per contract year; (c) a non-production Platform sandbox environment; and (d) a named partner manager.

clauses.title: Datavane obligations
clauses.text: Datavane may, in its discretion, provide Partner with pre-sales support, marketing development funds and co-marketing materials.

clauses.title: Datavane accounts - Ownership of Relationship
clauses.text: Ownership of Relationship. Partner acknowledges that each Datavane Account is a customer relationship of Datavane. All information relating to Datavane Accounts, including contact details, requirements, usage data and pricing, shall be Datavane's Confidential Information.

clauses.title: Datavane accounts - Registration of Existing Clients
clauses.text: Registration of Existing Clients. Where Partner proposes the Platform to an existing client of Partner, Partner shall register such client in the Partner Portal as a Prospect, whereupon such client shall become a Datavane Account.

clauses.title: Datavane accounts - Non-Solicitation of Datavane Accounts
clauses.text: Non-Solicitation of Datavane Accounts. During the Term and for a period of twenty-four (24) months following expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Partner shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, directly or indirectly solicit, market to, or provide any implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse, data platform or analytics platform other than the Datavane Platform.

clauses.title: Datavane accounts - Transition of Accounts
clauses.text: Transition of Accounts. Upon expiration or termination, Partner shall, at Datavane's request, provide reasonable cooperation in transitioning all Partner Services for Datavane Accounts to Datavane or to a partner designated by Datavane.

clauses.title: Fees and revenue share - Joint Deal Revenue Share
clauses.text: Joint Deal Revenue Share. Joint Deal Revenue shall be shared between the Parties in the proportion of eighty percent (80%) to Datavane and twenty percent (20%) to Partner, irrespective of whether Platform subscription fees or Partner Services fees are the larger component of such Joint Deal.

clauses.title: Fees and revenue share - Billing
clauses.text: Billing. Datavane shall invoice Datavane Accounts for all Joint Deal Revenue, unless Datavane agrees in writing that Partner may invoice Partner Services directly, in which case Partner shall remit Datavane's share within thirty (30) days of Partner's invoice date.

clauses.title: Fees and revenue share - Payment to Partner
clauses.text: Payment to Partner. Datavane shall pay Partner's share of Joint Deal Revenue within sixty (60) days after the end of the calendar quarter in which Datavane receives payment from the relevant Datavane Account.

clauses.title: Fees and revenue share - Referral Fee
clauses.text: Referral Fee. For Prospects referred by Partner that purchase a Platform subscription without Partner Services, Datavane shall pay Partner a referral fee of eight percent (8%) of first-year net subscription fees actually received by Datavane.

clauses.title: Fees and revenue share - Taxes
clauses.text: Taxes. Each Party shall bear its own taxes. Any withholding tax required by law shall be deducted from payments and the paying Party shall provide the relevant withholding certificate.

clauses.title: Fees and revenue share - Currency
clauses.text: Currency. All amounts under this Agreement are in United States Dollars.

clauses.title: Fees and revenue share - Audit
clauses.text: Audit. Datavane may, upon fifteen (15) days' notice, audit Partner's records relating to Joint Deals and Partner Services.

clauses.title: Term and termination - Term
clauses.text: Term. This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of three (3) years, and thereafter renews automatically for successive one (1) year periods unless Datavane gives notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term (the "Term").

clauses.title: Term and termination - Termination for Convenience by Datavane
clauses.text: Termination for Convenience by Datavane. Datavane may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason or no reason, upon fifteen (15) days' written notice to Partner.

clauses.title: Term and termination - No Termination for Convenience by Partner
clauses.text: No Termination for Convenience by Partner. Partner acknowledges the investment made by Datavane in enabling Partner and agrees that Partner may not terminate this Agreement for convenience during the initial term.

clauses.title: Term and termination - Termination for Cause
clauses.text: Termination for Cause. Either Party may terminate this Agreement upon written notice if the other Party materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure such breach within thirty (30) days after written notice. Datavane may terminate immediately upon written notice if Partner breaches Section 3.3, 3.4 or 5.

clauses.title: Term and termination - Effect of Termination
clauses.text: Effect of Termination. Upon expiration or termination: (a) all rights granted to Partner shall terminate; (b) Partner shall cease use of Datavane's Marks and return or destroy Datavane's Confidential Information; (c) no revenue share or referral fee shall be payable in respect of any Joint Deal or referral not fully paid by the relevant Datavane Account before the effective date of termination; and (d) Sections 1, 5.1, 5.3, 5.4, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 and 13 shall survive.

clauses.title: Intellectual property and marks
clauses.text: Datavane retains all right, title and interest in the Platform, its documentation, the Partner Portal and all related intellectual property.

clauses.title: Intellectual property and marks
clauses.text: Datavane grants Partner a non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable licence during the Term to use Datavane's Marks in the Territory solely to promote the Platform in accordance with Datavane's brand guidelines.

clauses.title: Intellectual property and marks
clauses.text: Partner grants Datavane a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to use Partner's name and logo in Datavane's partner directory and marketing materials.

clauses.title: Intellectual property and marks
clauses.text: Partner hereby grants Datavane a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to use any feedback, connectors, templates or implementation accelerators that Partner submits to the Datavane Partner Marketplace.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: "Confidential Information" means all non-public information disclosed by a Party that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential, including information relating to Datavane Accounts.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each Party shall hold the other's Confidential Information in confidence, use it only for the purposes of this Agreement, and disclose it only to personnel and advisers with a need to know who are bound by obligations at least as protective.

clauses.title: Confidentiality

clauses.title: Indemnification - By Partner
clauses.text: By Partner. Partner shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Datavane, its Affiliates and their respective directors, officers, employees and agents from and against any and all Losses arising out of or relating to (a) the Partner Services; (b) any breach of this Agreement by Partner or its Affiliates; (c) any representation made by Partner regarding the Platform; (d) any claim by a Datavane Account relating to Partner Services or any Joint Deal; or (e) any act or omission of Partner's personnel or subcontractors. clauses.title: Indemnification - By Datavane
clauses.text: By Datavane. Datavane shall defend Partner against any third-party claim alleging that the Platform, as provided by Datavane, infringes a United States patent or copyright, and shall pay damages finally awarded, subject to Section 12.2.

clauses.title: Indemnification - Procedure
clauses.text: Procedure. The indemnified Party shall give prompt written notice of the claim, allow the indemnifying Party to control the defence and settlement, and provide reasonable cooperation.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability - Exclusion
clauses.text: Exclusion. IN NO EVENT SHALL DATAVANE BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, OR FOR LOSS OF PROFITS, REVENUE, BUSINESS OR GOODWILL, ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability - Cap on Datavane Liability
clauses.text: Cap on Datavane Liability. DATAVANE'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT, INCLUDING UNDER SECTION 11.2, SHALL NOT EXCEED TEN THOUSAND UNITED STATES DOLLARS (USD 10,000).

clauses.title: Limitation of liability - Partner Liability
clauses.text: Partner Liability. NOTHING IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL LIMIT PARTNER'S LIABILITY UNDER SECTION 5, SECTION 9 OR SECTION 11.1.

clauses.title: Governing law and disputes - Governing Law
clauses.text: Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. The United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods shall not apply.

clauses.title: Governing law and disputes - Venue
clauses.text: Venue. Any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be brought exclusively in the state or federal courts located in the City and County of San Francisco, California, and each Party irrevocably submits to the personal jurisdiction of such courts and waives any objection based on inconvenient forum.

clauses.title: Governing law and disputes - Injunctive Relief
clauses.text: Injunctive Relief. Datavane may seek injunctive or other equitable relief in any court of competent jurisdiction to enforce Sections 5, 8 or 9.

clauses.title: General - Relationship
clauses.text: Relationship. The Parties are independent contractors. Nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership, joint venture, franchise, employment or agency relationship.

clauses.title: General - Assignment
clauses.text: Assignment. Partner may not assign this Agreement, by operation of law, change of control or otherwise, without Datavane's prior written consent. Datavane may assign this Agreement without consent.

clauses.title: General - Amendments to Program Terms
clauses.text: Amendments to Program Terms. Datavane may update the Global Partner Program Guide, certification requirements and Partner Portal terms from time to time upon notice to Partner, and such updates shall form part of this Agreement.

clauses.title: General - Notices
clauses.text: Notices. Notices shall be in writing and delivered by courier or email to the addresses above: if to Datavane, Attn: Rachel Kim, VP Global Partnerships, with a copy to legal@datavane.com; if to Partner, Attn: Director.

clauses.title: General - Force Majeure
clauses.text: Force Majeure. Neither Party shall be liable for delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control, except for payment obligations.

clauses.title: General - Severability; Waiver
clauses.text: Severability; Waiver. If any provision is held invalid, the remainder shall continue in effect. No waiver is effective unless in writing.

clauses.title: General - Entire Agreement
clauses.text: Entire Agreement. This Agreement, together with the Global Partner Program Guide, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes all prior discussions and agreements relating to its subject matter.

clauses.title: General - Counterparts
clauses.text: Counterparts. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature.

clauses.title: Preamble
clauses.text: Client provides industrial analytics and predictive maintenance software to mid-sized manufacturing companies in the DACH region. Client intends to replace the batch-based data ingestion layer of its "Rheinwerk Insight" platform with a scalable, near-real-time data pipeline architecture. Supplier has experience in the design and implementation of cloud data pipelines. The Parties therefore agree as follows.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Platform" means Client's Rheinwerk Insight software-as-a-service platform.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Work Results" means all results created by Supplier for Client under this Agreement, including source code, configurations, pipeline definitions, documentation and test cases.

clauses.title: Definitions

clauses.title: Definitions

clauses.title: Definitions

clauses.title: Definitions

clauses.title: Subject Matter and Scope of Services
Subject Matter and Scope of Services

clauses.title: Subject Matter and Scope of Services

clauses.title: Remuneration and Payment

clauses.text: Supplier shall invoice each Milestone Fee after acceptance of the relevant Milestone. Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of receipt without deduction.

Withholding taxes, if any, shall be handled in accordance with the applicable double taxation agreement between Germany and India, and Client shall provide the relevant certificates.

clauses.text: Supplier shall deliver the services using its proprietary data-pipeline accelerator "PipeKit", comprising reusable ingestion connectors, transformation templates, data quality rule libraries and orchestration modules. PipeKit shall be incorporated into the Work Results to reduce implementation time and cost.

clauses.title: Supplier Tools and Rights of Use

Client may sub-license this right to its affiliated companies and to service providers acting on its behalf.

clauses.title: Supplier Tools and Rights of Use

clauses.text: The Parties shall be liable without limitation for damage caused intentionally or by gross negligence, for injury to life, body or health, and under the Product Liability Act (Produkthaftungsgesetz).

clauses.title: Liability

clauses.title: Liability
clauses.text: Otherwise, liability for slight negligence is excluded.

clauses.title: Liability

clauses.title: Indemnification

clauses.title: Confidentiality

clauses.title: Confidentiality

clauses.title: Term, Termination, Changes
clauses.text: This Agreement enters into force upon signature by both Parties and ends upon acceptance of the final Milestone and expiry of the warranty period.

clauses.title: Term, Termination, Changes
clauses.text: The right of either Party to terminate for good cause (aus wichtigem Grund) remains unaffected. Good cause exists in particular if the other Party materially breaches its obligations and fails to remedy the breach within thirty (30) days of written notice. Upon termination by Client for convenience (§ 648 BGB), Supplier shall be entitled to the agreed remuneration for services rendered plus compensation for committed costs.

clauses.title: Term, Termination, Changes
clauses.text: Change requests shall be submitted in writing. Supplier shall assess the impact on effort, schedule and remuneration within five (5) working days. Changes become binding only when agreed in writing.

clauses.title: Data Protection
clauses.text: To the extent Supplier processes personal data on behalf of Client, the Parties shall conclude the Data Processing Agreement pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR attached as Annex 3, which forms an integral part of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Data Protection
clauses.text: Transfers of personal data to India shall be based on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (Module 2, Controller-to-Processor) incorporated in Annex 3, supplemented by the technical and organisational measures described therein.

clauses.title: Data Protection
clauses.text: Supplier shall ensure that its personnel are bound to confidentiality and data secrecy and receive appropriate data protection training.

clauses.title: Governing Law and Place of Jurisdiction
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG).

clauses.title: Governing Law and Place of Jurisdiction
clauses.text: The exclusive place of jurisdiction for all disputes arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be Munich, Germany.

clauses.title: Final Provisions

Gulf Crown Hotels & Resorts Co. — Digital Transformation Programme
Agreement Reference: GCHR/IT/MSA/2026/047
This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is made and entered into on the  day of  2026 (the "Effective Date").

clauses.title: Parties
clauses.text: Gulf Crown Hotels & Resorts Co., a closed joint stock company incorporated under the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, holding Commercial Registration No. 1010584431, with its head office at King Fahd Road, Al Olaya District, P.O. Box 88214, Riyadh 11662, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (the "Company"); and

clauses.title: Parties
clauses.text:
AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, a private limited company incorporated under the laws of the Republic of India, bearing CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456, with its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India (the "Service Provider").
The Company and the Service Provider are each referred to as a "Party" and together as the "Parties".

clauses.title: Recitals
clauses.text: WHEREAS the Company owns and operates a portfolio of hotels and resorts within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and wishes to modernise its commercial and guest-facing operations in line with its Digital Transformation Programme;

clauses.title: Recitals
clauses.text: WHEREAS the Service Provider has represented that it possesses the requisite expertise, qualified personnel and experience in data platforms, analytics and artificial intelligence to design, build and deploy the Platform described herein;

clauses.title: Recitals
clauses.text:
AND WHEREAS the Company, relying upon the representations of the Service Provider, wishes to engage the Service Provider, and the Service Provider wishes to be engaged, upon the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.
NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties, having full legal capacity to contract, have agreed as follows.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Platform" means the revenue management and guest analytics platform to be delivered by the Service Provider under this Agreement, as further described in Clause 4 and Schedule 1.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Properties" means the hotels and resorts owned or operated by the Company and listed in Schedule 2.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Deliverables" means all software, dashboards, models, documentation, reports and other materials to be provided by the Service Provider under this Agreement.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Milestone" means each stage of the Services identified in Schedule 3, together with its associated completion date.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Contract Value" means the total fees payable under this Agreement, being One Hundred and Forty Thousand United States Dollars (USD 140,000).

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Business Day" means any day other than a Friday, Saturday or official public holiday in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Confidential Information" means all information disclosed by one Party to the other, whether oral, written or electronic, that is designated as confidential or that ought reasonably to be understood as confidential.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Guest Data" means any personal data relating to guests, members of the Company's loyalty programme, or prospective guests of the Properties.

clauses.title: Scope of services
clauses.text: The Service Provider shall design, develop, test, deploy and support a revenue management and guest analytics platform for the Company's nine (9) Properties located in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, as listed in Schedule 2.

clauses.title: Scope of services
Scope of services
clauses.text: The Service Provider shall perform the Services in accordance with the specifications set out in Schedule 1, the Milestones set out in Schedule 3, and any reasonable instructions issued by the Company's Project Director.

clauses.title: Scope of services
clauses.text: The Service Provider shall deploy a dedicated project manager who shall be available during Riyadh business hours and shall attend on-site at the Company's head office as reasonably requested.

clauses.title: Scope of services
clauses.text: Any change to the scope of Services shall be agreed in writing through a change request signed by authorised representatives of both Parties.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: In consideration of the Services, the Company shall pay the Service Provider the Contract Value in accordance with the payment schedule in Schedule 3.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: The Service Provider shall submit an invoice upon the Company's written acceptance of each Milestone. Invoices shall be addressed to the Company's Finance Department and shall reference the Agreement Reference number.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: The Company shall pay each undisputed invoice within sixty (60) days from the date of receipt of a valid invoice.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: All fees are exclusive of Value Added Tax. Where the Company is required by law to withhold any tax from payments, the Company shall deduct such tax and provide the Service Provider with the relevant withholding certificate.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: The Company may dispute any invoice in good faith by written notice within fifteen (15) Business Days of receipt, and the Parties shall endeavour to resolve such dispute amicably.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: All payments shall be made in United States Dollars by bank transfer to the account nominated by the Service Provider in writing.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue for a period of thirty-six (36) months, unless terminated earlier in accordance with this Clause 6.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Either Party may terminate this Agreement by written notice if the other Party commits a material breach and fails to remedy such breach within thirty (30) days of receiving written notice thereof.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days' written notice, in which event the Company shall pay for all Services performed and accepted up to the date of termination.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Either Party may terminate this Agreement immediately if the other Party becomes insolvent, enters into liquidation or makes any arrangement with its creditors.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Upon termination, the Service Provider shall deliver to the Company all Deliverables and work in progress, and shall provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to sixty (60) days.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each Party shall keep confidential all Confidential Information of the other Party and shall not disclose it to any third party without prior written consent, save to its employees, advisers and subcontractors who need to know it for the purposes of this Agreement and who are bound by obligations of confidentiality no less stringent than those herein.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: The obligations in this Clause 7 shall not apply to information which is or becomes publicly available other than through breach of this Agreement, was lawfully in the receiving Party's possession prior to disclosure, or is required to be disclosed by law or by a competent authority.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: The obligations in this Clause 7 shall survive for a period of five (5) years following the expiry or termination of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: All Deliverables specifically created for the Company under this Agreement shall, upon payment in full, become the property of the Company.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: The Service Provider shall retain ownership of its pre-existing tools, methodologies and know-how ("Background IP"). To the extent any Background IP is incorporated into the Deliverables, the Service Provider grants the Company a non-exclusive, perpetual, royalty-free licence to use such Background IP solely as part of the Deliverables for the Company's internal business purposes.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: The Company shall retain all rights in its data, including Guest Data, and in any materials provided by the Company to the Service Provider.

clauses.title: Warranties
Warranties
clauses.text: The Service Provider shall, at its own cost, remedy any defect notified by the Company during the warranty period.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect, special or consequential loss, or loss of profits, arising out of or in connection with this Agreement.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Save in respect of liability arising from fraud, wilful misconduct, breach of Clause 7 (Confidentiality) or Clause 13 (Data Protection), each Party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the Contract Value.

clauses.title: Indemnity
clauses.text: The Service Provider shall indemnify the Company against all losses, claims and expenses arising from any claim by a third party that the Deliverables infringe the intellectual property rights of such third party.

clauses.title: Indemnity
clauses.text: The Company shall indemnify the Service Provider against claims arising from the Service Provider's use, in accordance with this Agreement, of materials supplied by the Company.

clauses.title: Delay penalties
clauses.text: Time shall be of the essence in respect of the Milestone dates set out in Schedule 3.

clauses.title: Delay penalties
clauses.text: Should the Service Provider fail to achieve any Milestone by its scheduled completion date, the Service Provider shall pay to the Company, by way of liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to one percent (1%) of the Contract Value for each week or part thereof of delay.

clauses.title: Delay penalties
clauses.text: The aggregate liquidated damages payable under this Clause 12 shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the Contract Value.

clauses.title: Delay penalties
clauses.text: The Company may deduct any liquidated damages due from any amount payable to the Service Provider under this Agreement.

clauses.title: Delay penalties
clauses.text: The Service Provider shall not be liable for delay to the extent such delay is caused by a Force Majeure Event as defined in Clause 15.

clauses.title: Data protection
clauses.text: The Service Provider shall process Guest Data only on the documented instructions of the Company and in compliance with the Personal Data Protection Law issued by Royal Decree No. M/19 and its Implementing Regulations, and any other applicable law in the Kingdom.

clauses.title: Data protection
clauses.text: Guest Data shall be hosted within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia unless the Company provides prior written approval for any transfer outside the Kingdom.

clauses.title: Data protection
clauses.text: The Service Provider shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect Guest Data and shall notify the Company of any personal data breach within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware of it.

clauses.title: Governing law and dispute resolution
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws and regulations in force in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

clauses.title: Governing law and dispute resolution
clauses.text: The Parties shall seek to resolve any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement amicably through negotiation between senior executives within thirty (30) days.

clauses.title: Governing law and dispute resolution
clauses.text: Failing amicable resolution, the dispute shall be referred to the competent courts in the City of Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, which shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

clauses.title: General provisions - Force Majeure
clauses.text: Force Majeure. Neither Party shall be liable for failure to perform its obligations where such failure results from events beyond its reasonable control, including acts of God, war, epidemic or governmental action ("Force Majeure Event").

clauses.title: General provisions - Assignment
clauses.text: Assignment. The Service Provider shall not assign or subcontract any of its obligations without the prior written consent of the Company.

clauses.title: General provisions - Language
clauses.text: Language. This Agreement is executed in English and Arabic. In the event of any inconsistency, the Arabic text shall prevail.

clauses.title: General provisions - Notices
clauses.text: Notices. All notices shall be in writing and delivered by hand, courier or email to the addresses set out in Clause 1, marked for the attention of the Company's Chief Technology Officer (Mr. Faisal Al-Otaibi) and the Service Provider's Chief Executive Officer respectively.

clauses.title: General provisions - Entire Agreement
clauses.text: Entire Agreement. This Agreement, together with its Schedules, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes all prior negotiations and understandings.

clauses.title: General provisions - Amendment
clauses.text: Amendment. No amendment shall be effective unless in writing and signed by both Parties.

clauses.title: General provisions - Counterparts
clauses.text: Counterparts. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original.

clauses.title: Specifications (summary)
clauses.text:
- Cloud hosting within KSA region; availability target 99.5% monthly.
- Daily refresh of forecasting models; rate recommendations published by 07:00 local time.
- Role-based access control aligned with Company's Active Directory.
- Bilingual (Arabic / English) user interface and reports.

findings.clauseTitle: Delay penalties - delay damages
findings.whyItMatters: Karandeep's checklist: 'LDs → cap it. never open ended.' AtliQ's standard (Acme, Northwind, Trustline) is 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week, capped at 5% of that milestone, with no LDs for client-caused delay. The 10% cap matches Al Noor's, which Karandeep approved as 'a strategic exception for Al Noor only, not our new standard'.

Harrington Health Systems, Inc. — Contract No. HHS-IT-2026-0193, Exhibit D
Form: HHS Business Associate Agreement (Rev. 03/2026)
This Business Associate Agreement (this "BAA") is entered into as of the Effective Date of the Master Services Agreement (as defined below) by and between Harrington Health Systems, Inc., a Texas nonprofit corporation with its principal place of business at 6400 Fannin Street, Suite 1800, Houston, Texas 77030, on behalf of itself and its Affiliates that are covered entities ("Covered Entity" or "Harrington"), and AtliQ Inc, a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business at 101 College Road East, Suite 210, Princeton, New Jersey 08540 ("Business Associate").

clauses.title: Recitals
Definitions
clauses.text: "HIPAA" means the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996, the Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health Act (Title XIII of the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009), and the regulations at 45 C.F.R. Parts 160, 162 and 164, each as amended.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Protected Health Information" or "PHI" has the meaning given at 45 C.F.R. § 160.103, limited to information created, received, maintained or transmitted by Business Associate or any Subcontractor on behalf of Covered Entity, and includes electronic PHI.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Security Incident" has the meaning given at 45 C.F.R. § 164.304.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Breach" has the meaning given at 45 C.F.R. § 164.402.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Subcontractor" means any person or entity, including any Affiliate of Business Associate, to whom Business Associate delegates a function, activity or service under the Master Services Agreement, other than in the capacity of a member of Business Associate's workforce.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Privacy Event" means any (a) Security Incident; (b) Breach; (c) use or disclosure of PHI not permitted by this BAA; or (d) suspected occurrence of any of the foregoing.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Texas Privacy Law" means the Texas Medical Records Privacy Act (Tex. Health & Safety Code ch. 181) and Tex. Bus. & Com. Code ch. 521.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: Capitalized terms used but not defined in this BAA have the meanings given in HIPAA or, if not defined there, in the Master Services Agreement.

clauses.title: Permitted uses and disclosures
clauses.text: Business Associate may use or disclose PHI solely as necessary to perform the Services under the Master Services Agreement, in compliance with this BAA and the minimum necessary standard at 45 C.F.R. § 164.502(b).

clauses.title: Permitted uses and disclosures
clauses.text: Business Associate may use PHI for its proper management and administration or to carry out its legal responsibilities, and may disclose PHI for such purposes only if Required By Law or if Business Associate obtains reasonable written assurances from the recipient as required by 45 C.F.R. § 164.504(e)(4).

clauses.title: Permitted uses and disclosures
clauses.text: Business Associate shall not (a) sell PHI; (b) use or disclose PHI for marketing or fundraising; (c) perform Data Aggregation services except as expressly authorized in writing by Covered Entity; or (d) use or disclose PHI in any manner that would violate Subpart E of 45 C.F.R. Part 164 if done by Covered Entity.

clauses.title: Permitted uses and disclosures
clauses.text: Business Associate shall not de-identify PHI, or use de-identified information derived from PHI for any purpose other than the Services, without Covered Entity's prior written approval.

clauses.title: Safeguards
clauses.text: Business Associate shall implement administrative, physical and technical safeguards that reasonably and appropriately protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of electronic PHI, and shall comply with Subpart C of 45 C.F.R. Part 164.

clauses.title: Safeguards
clauses.text: Business Associate shall comply with the Client Information Security Requirements set forth in Exhibit B to the Master Services Agreement, including encryption of PHI at rest and in transit, multi-factor authentication, and logging and monitoring of all access to PHI.

clauses.title: Safeguards
clauses.text: Business Associate shall ensure that all members of its workforce with access to PHI have completed HIPAA privacy and security training prior to access and annually thereafter, and shall provide training records upon request.

clauses.title: Safeguards
clauses.text: Business Associate shall apply sanctions against members of its workforce who fail to comply with its privacy and security policies, consistent with 45 C.F.R. § 164.530(e), and shall promptly revoke access to PHI upon termination or reassignment of any such person.

clauses.title: Safeguards
clauses.text: Business Associate shall maintain a documented security risk analysis covering all systems used to access PHI in accordance with 45 C.F.R. § 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(A), and shall update it at least annually.

clauses.text: Domestic Performance. Business Associate shall not, and shall ensure that no Subcontractor shall, access, view, create, receive, maintain, transmit, store or process PHI from or at any location outside the United States, whether directly or by remote access.
