CloudSpan Agreement No.: CSP-PTN-IN-2025-031
Effective Date: 1 September 2025

clauses.title: Parties
clauses.text:
This Strategic Partnership Agreement (the "Agreement") is made between:
1. CLOUDSPAN TECHNOLOGIES PTE. LTD., a company incorporated in Singapore (UEN 201834567K), having its registered office at 8 Marina View, #29-01 Asia Square Tower 1, Singapore 018960 ("CloudSpan"); and
2. ATLIQ TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED, a private limited company incorporated under the laws of India (CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456; GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3), having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("Partner"),
each a "Party" and together the "Parties".

clauses.title: Recitals
clauses.text:
A. CloudSpan provides the CloudSpan Platform, a cloud lakehouse and data-warehouse platform offered as a service.
B. Partner provides software, data engineering, analytics, business intelligence and AI/ML services to enterprise customers.
C. The Parties wish to establish a strategic relationship under which Partner will implement the CloudSpan Platform for customers and refer prospective customers to CloudSpan, on the terms of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Affiliate" means, in relation to a Party, any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with that Party, where "control" means ownership of more than fifty per cent (50%) of the voting securities or the power to direct management.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "CloudSpan Platform" means CloudSpan's cloud lakehouse and data-warehouse service, together with associated tools, connectors and documentation made generally available by CloudSpan from time to time.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Customer" means a third party that subscribes to the CloudSpan Platform directly from CloudSpan.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Referred Customer" means a Customer introduced by Partner through a Referral Registration accepted by CloudSpan under Clause 4.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Referral Registration" means a registration of a prospective customer submitted by Partner through the CloudSpan Partner Portal.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "First-Year Subscription Fees" means the subscription fees actually received by CloudSpan from a Referred Customer for the first twelve (12) months of its initial subscription, excluding taxes, professional services fees, usage overages billed separately and refunds or credits.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Certified Engineer" means an employee of Partner who holds a current CloudSpan Certified Implementation Engineer credential.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Implementation Services" means services provided by Partner to Customers for the design, migration, configuration, integration and deployment of solutions on the CloudSpan Platform.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Competing Platform" has the meaning given in Clause 7.2.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Territory" means the Republic of India and the member states of the Gulf Cooperation Council, being the United Arab Emirates, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the State of Qatar, the State of Kuwait, the Kingdom of Bahrain and the Sultanate of Oman.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Marks" means a Party's trade names, trade marks, logos and partner badges.

clauses.title: Appointment
clauses.text: CloudSpan appoints Partner as a Premier Implementation and Referral Partner for the CloudSpan Platform. Partner accepts the appointment.

clauses.title: Appointment
clauses.text: Save as provided in Clause 7, the appointment is non-exclusive. CloudSpan may appoint other partners in any territory, and Partner may operate outside the Territory without restriction.

clauses.title: Appointment
clauses.text: Partner is not appointed as a reseller. Customers contract with and pay CloudSpan directly for subscriptions to the CloudSpan Platform.

clauses.title: Partner commitments
clauses.text: Partner shall maintain, throughout the Term, not fewer than four (4) Certified Engineers. Where the number falls below four (4) for reasons outside Partner's reasonable control, Partner shall have ninety (90) days to restore it.

clauses.title: Partner commitments
clauses.text: Partner shall deliver Implementation Services with reasonable skill and care, in accordance with CloudSpan's published implementation guidelines, and shall be solely responsible to Customers for Implementation Services it contracts to provide.

clauses.title: Partner commitments
clauses.text: Partner shall not make any representation or warranty concerning the CloudSpan Platform beyond those contained in CloudSpan's published documentation.

clauses.title: Partner commitments
clauses.text: Partner shall participate in a joint business-planning review with CloudSpan at least once every six (6) months.

clauses.title: Referrals and referral fees
clauses.text: Partner may submit Referral Registrations for prospective customers. CloudSpan shall accept or reject each Referral Registration within ten (10) business days. A registration shall be rejected only where the prospect is an existing Customer or is already the subject of an active opportunity registered by CloudSpan or another partner in the preceding ninety (90) days.

clauses.title: Referrals and referral fees
clauses.text: An accepted Referral Registration shall remain valid for one hundred and eighty (180) days. If the prospect signs a subscription order with CloudSpan within that period, it becomes a Referred Customer.

clauses.title: Referrals and referral fees
clauses.text: CloudSpan shall pay Partner a referral fee equal to twelve per cent (12%) of the First-Year Subscription Fees received from each Referred Customer (the "Referral Fee").

clauses.title: Referrals and referral fees
clauses.text: CloudSpan shall provide Partner with a quarterly statement of Referral Fees within fifteen (15) days of the end of each calendar quarter. Partner shall invoice CloudSpan on the basis of that statement, and CloudSpan shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt.

clauses.title: Referrals and referral fees
clauses.text: Referral Fees are exclusive of GST and other applicable taxes. Where CloudSpan is required by law to withhold tax, it shall provide Partner with the relevant certificate to enable Partner to claim credit.

clauses.title: Referrals and referral fees
clauses.text: Partner may, on reasonable notice and not more than once per year, have CloudSpan's records relating to Referral Fees reviewed by an independent accountant, at Partner's cost, unless an underpayment of more than five per cent (5%) is found, in which case CloudSpan shall bear the cost.

clauses.title: Cloudspan commitments
Cloudspan commitments
clauses.text: CloudSpan shall list Partner in its public partner directory for the Territory and shall use reasonable efforts to refer Implementation Services opportunities in the Territory to Partner.

clauses.title: Cloudspan commitments
clauses.text: The Parties shall agree an annual co-marketing plan. CloudSpan shall contribute market development funds of up to USD 25,000 per contract year for jointly approved activities.

clauses.title: Marketing and use of marks
clauses.text: Each Party grants the other a non-exclusive, non-transferable, royalty-free licence during the Term to use its Marks solely to identify the partnership, in accordance with the owning Party's brand guidelines.

clauses.title: Marketing and use of marks
clauses.text: Neither Party shall issue any press release concerning this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other, not to be unreasonably withheld.

clauses.title: Exclusivity
clauses.text: In consideration of the Referral Fees, market development funds and other benefits under this Agreement, during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.

clauses.title: Exclusivity
clauses.text: "Competing Platform" means any cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or unified analytics platform offered as a service.

clauses.title: Exclusivity
clauses.text: For clarity, Clause 7.1 does not restrict Partner or its Affiliates from (a) providing services outside India and the GCC; or (b) providing services to a customer that has independently selected a platform, provided Partner does not hold a partner appointment with, or receive any fee or benefit from, the provider of that platform.

clauses.title: Exclusivity
clauses.text: In this Clause 7, "GCC" has the meaning given to the member states listed in the definition of Territory.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: Each Party retains all rights in its own intellectual property. CloudSpan owns the CloudSpan Platform and all improvements to it.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: Partner retains all rights in its own methodologies, accelerators, tools, templates and know-how, whether developed before or during the Term, including those used in delivering Implementation Services.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: Any feedback provided by Partner concerning the CloudSpan Platform may be used by CloudSpan without restriction, provided Partner's Confidential Information is not disclosed.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each Party shall keep confidential all non-public information disclosed by the other in connection with this Agreement ("Confidential Information"), use it only for the purposes of this Agreement, and disclose it only to its employees, Affiliates and advisers who need to know it and are bound by equivalent obligations.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Clause 9.1 does not apply to information that is public other than through breach, already lawfully known, lawfully received from a third party, or independently developed, or to disclosure required by law.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: The obligations in this Clause 9 survive for three (3) years after termination or expiry.

clauses.title: Data protection
clauses.text: Each Party shall comply with data protection laws applicable to it. Where Partner processes Customer personal data in providing Implementation Services, it does so under its own agreement with that Customer.

clauses.title: Data protection
clauses.text: Referral Registrations shall contain only business contact information that Partner is entitled to share.

clauses.title: Warranties
clauses.text: Each Party warrants that it has full power and authority to enter into this Agreement and that doing so does not breach any other agreement binding on it.

clauses.title: Warranties
clauses.text: Save as expressly stated, all warranties, conditions and representations, whether express or implied, are excluded to the extent permitted by law.

clauses.title: Indemnities
clauses.text: CloudSpan shall indemnify Partner against third-party claims that the CloudSpan Platform infringes that third party's intellectual property rights.

clauses.title: Indemnities
clauses.text: Partner shall indemnify CloudSpan against third-party claims that Partner's own materials or Implementation Services infringe that third party's intellectual property rights.

clauses.title: Indemnities
clauses.text: The indemnified Party shall notify the other promptly of any claim, allow it conduct of the defence and provide reasonable assistance at its cost.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Neither Party shall be liable for any indirect, consequential or special loss, or loss of profit, revenue or goodwill.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Each Party's aggregate liability under this Agreement in any contract year shall not exceed the greater of (a) the total Referral Fees paid or payable in the preceding twelve (12) months and (b) USD 100,000.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Clauses 13.1 and 13.2 do not apply to liability under Clause 12, breach of Clause 9, or liability that cannot be limited by law.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for three (3) years, until 31 August 2028 (the "Term"), unless terminated earlier. The Parties may renew it by written agreement.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving not less than ninety (90) days' written notice to the other.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Either Party may terminate this Agreement with immediate effect by written notice if the other Party commits a material breach that is incapable of remedy, or that is not remedied within thirty (30) days of written notice, or becomes insolvent.

clauses.title: Term and termination
Governing law and dispute resolution
clauses.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of Singapore.

clauses.title: Governing law and dispute resolution
clauses.text: The Parties shall first attempt to resolve any dispute through good-faith discussions between senior executives for thirty (30) days.

clauses.title: Governing law and dispute resolution
clauses.text: Any dispute not so resolved shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration administered by the Singapore International Arbitration Centre ("SIAC") under the SIAC Rules in force at the time. The seat of arbitration shall be Singapore. The tribunal shall consist of one (1) arbitrator. The language of arbitration shall be English.

clauses.title: General - Relationship
clauses.text: Relationship. The Parties are independent contractors. Nothing in this Agreement creates a partnership in law, joint venture, agency or employment relationship.

clauses.title: General - Non-solicitation
clauses.text: Non-solicitation. During the Term and for six (6) months thereafter, neither Party shall actively solicit for employment any employee of the other Party with whom it had material contact under this Agreement. General advertisements are not solicitation.

clauses.title: General - Assignment
clauses.text: Assignment. Neither Party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other, except to an Affiliate or successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets, on written notice.

clauses.title: General - Force majeure
clauses.text: Force majeure. Neither Party is liable for delay or failure caused by events beyond its reasonable control.

clauses.title: General - Notices
clauses.text: Notices. Notices shall be in writing and sent to the addresses above, with a copy by email: for CloudSpan to partnerships-legal@cloudspan.io (attention: Wei Lin Tan, Head of Partnerships); for Partner to karandeep@atliq.com.

clauses.title: General - Entire agreement
clauses.text: Entire agreement. This Agreement is the entire agreement between the Parties on its subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions. It may be amended only in writing signed by both Parties.

clauses.title: General - Counterparts
clauses.text: Counterparts. This Agreement may be executed electronically and in counterparts.

clauses.title: Parties
clauses.text: NORTHWIND LOGISTICS LIMITED, a company incorporated in England and Wales (company number 08813527), whose registered office is at Unit 7, Trafford Wharf Road, Trafford Park, Manchester M17 1EX, United Kingdom ("Client"); and

clauses.title: Background
clauses.text:
(A) The Client operates warehousing and road-freight services across the United Kingdom and wishes to modernise its operational data pipelines and reporting.
(B) The Supplier provides data engineering and analytics services and has agreed to provide the Services on the terms of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Definitions

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Client Materials" means all data, documents and information provided by or on behalf of the Client.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Deliverables" means all work product, software, code, pipelines, configurations, documentation and other materials created, supplied or delivered by the Supplier to the Client in the course of the Services.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Effective Date" means 20 June 2025.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Intellectual Property Rights" means patents, copyright, database rights, rights in software, trade marks, know-how and all similar rights anywhere in the world, whether registered or not.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Milestone" and "Milestone Fee" have the meanings given in the relevant SOW.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Services" means the services described in each SOW.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "SOW" means a statement of work agreed and signed by both parties under this Agreement. SOW-1 is set out in Schedule 1.

clauses.title: Services
clauses.text: The Supplier shall provide the Services and Deliverables in accordance with this Agreement and each SOW.

clauses.title: Services
clauses.text: The Supplier shall perform the Services with reasonable skill, care and diligence, in accordance with good industry practice and the Client's reasonable IT and security policies notified in writing.

clauses.title: Services
clauses.text: The Client shall provide timely access to Client Materials, systems and personnel. Its nominated contact is Tom Beckett, Head of Operations.

clauses.title: Services
clauses.text: Any change to an SOW shall be agreed in writing via the change control procedure in Schedule 2.

clauses.title: Charges and payment
clauses.text: The Client shall pay the Charges in accordance with the relevant SOW. The Charges under SOW-1 total USD 54,000.

clauses.title: Charges and payment
clauses.text: The Supplier shall invoice on completion of each Milestone. The Client shall pay undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt.

clauses.title: Charges and payment
clauses.text: Charges are exclusive of VAT, which (if applicable) shall be accounted for by the Client under the reverse-charge mechanism.

clauses.title: Charges and payment
clauses.text: Where sums are overdue, the Supplier may charge interest at 2% per annum above the Bank of England base rate.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for three (3) years unless terminated earlier in accordance with this clause 6.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement on written notice if the other commits a material breach not remedied within thirty (30) days of notice, or suffers an insolvency event.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: The Client may terminate any SOW for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice, and shall pay for Services performed up to the date of termination.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: On termination the Supplier shall deliver to the Client all Deliverables (whether complete or in progress) and all Client Materials.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Clauses 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, 14 and 17 survive termination.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each party shall keep confidential all information of the other party which is marked as confidential or which ought reasonably to be considered confidential, and shall use it only for the purposes of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Clause 7.1 does not apply to information which is or becomes public (other than through breach), was already lawfully held, is independently developed, or must be disclosed by law or regulatory authority.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: This clause 7 continues for five (5) years after termination.

clauses.title: Supplier personnel
clauses.text: The Supplier shall ensure that its personnel are appropriately qualified and vetted, and shall remain responsible for all acts and omissions of its personnel and any approved subcontractors.

clauses.title: Supplier personnel
clauses.text: Neither party shall, during the term and for six (6) months afterwards, solicit any employee of the other party engaged in the Services.

clauses.title: Intellectual property

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: All Intellectual Property Rights in the Deliverables, including any software, tools, frameworks, libraries and pre-existing materials incorporated into the Deliverables, shall vest in the Client absolutely upon payment of the Charges for the relevant Milestone. The Supplier hereby assigns to the Client, with full title guarantee and by way of present assignment of future rights, all such Intellectual Property Rights with effect from such payment.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: The Supplier shall procure that its personnel waive all moral rights in the Deliverables, and shall execute such further documents as the Client may reasonably require to perfect the assignment in clause 9.2.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: All Client Materials and all Intellectual Property Rights in them remain the property of the Client. The Client grants the Supplier a non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use Client Materials solely to perform the Services.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: The Supplier shall deliver the source code for all software Deliverables to the Client's nominated repository on completion of each Milestone.

clauses.title: Warranties
clauses.text: The Supplier warrants that the Deliverables will conform materially to the SOW specification for sixty (60) days after acceptance, and that it will remedy any non-conformity notified within that period at no additional cost.

clauses.title: Warranties
clauses.text: The Supplier warrants that the Deliverables, and the Client's use of them, will not infringe the Intellectual Property Rights of any third party.

clauses.title: Warranties
clauses.text: Each party warrants that it has full capacity and authority to enter into this Agreement.

clauses.title: Delay and liquidated damages
clauses.text: If the Supplier fails to achieve a Milestone by its Milestone date, other than as a result of any act or omission of the Client (including late provision of Client Materials or system access) or a force majeure event, the Supplier shall pay the Client liquidated damages of 0.5% of the Milestone Fee for the affected Milestone for each full week of delay.

clauses.title: Delay and liquidated damages
clauses.text: The total liquidated damages for any Milestone shall not exceed 5% of that Milestone Fee.

clauses.title: Delay and liquidated damages
clauses.text: The parties agree that the liquidated damages are a genuine pre-estimate of the Client's loss and are the Client's sole financial remedy for the delay in question.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Nothing in this Agreement limits either party's liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation, or any liability which cannot be limited by law.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Neither party shall be liable for loss of profits, loss of business, or any indirect or consequential loss.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability

clauses.title: Indemnity
clauses.text: The Client shall indemnify the Supplier against all losses arising from any claim that the Client Materials infringe any third party's Intellectual Property Rights.

clauses.text: Each party shall comply with the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. To the extent the Supplier processes personal data on behalf of the Client, it shall do so only on the Client's documented instructions and in accordance with the data processing terms in Schedule 3.

clauses.title: Data protection

clauses.title: Force majeure

clauses.title: Assignment and subcontracting

clauses.title: Governing law and dispute resolution
clauses.text: This Agreement and any dispute or claim (including non-contractual disputes or claims) arising out of or in connection with it shall be governed by the law of England and Wales.

clauses.title: Governing law and dispute resolution
clauses.text: Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be referred to and finally resolved by arbitration under the LCIA Rules. The number of arbitrators shall be one. The seat of arbitration shall be London. The language of the arbitration shall be English.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties relating to its subject matter.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: No variation shall be effective unless in writing and signed by both parties.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: A person who is not a party has no rights under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999.

clauses.title: General

clauses.title: General

clauses.title: Statement of work 1 (sow-1) - Objectives
clauses.text: Objectives. Replace the Client's legacy nightly batch scripts with an automated, monitored data pipeline ingesting warehouse management system (WMS), telematics and transport management system (TMS) data into the Client's Azure data platform, and deliver daily operational KPI reporting.

The Supplier will build the pipeline using its proprietary pipeline accelerator, PipeKit, which provides pre-built ingestion connectors, orchestration templates, data-quality checks and monitoring components. PipeKit will be configured and extended for the Client and incorporated into the delivered pipeline as its ingestion and orchestration layer.

AtliQ Template: ATQ-FL-IN v2.1 (India Freelancer)
Agreement Date: 28 April 2025
This Independent Contractor Agreement (the "Agreement") is made between:
ATLIQ TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456; GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3), having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("AtliQ"); and
MR. ROHAN IYER, an individual residing at Flat 802, Sai Prestige, Aundh, Pune 411007, Maharashtra, India (PAN on file with AtliQ) (the "Contractor").

clauses.title: Engagement
clauses.text: AtliQ engages the Contractor as an independent contractor to provide the services described in the Engagement Schedule (the "Services"), and the Contractor accepts the engagement.

clauses.title: Engagement
clauses.text: The Contractor shall perform the Services personally and shall not subcontract any part of them without AtliQ's prior written consent.

clauses.title: Engagement
clauses.text: The Contractor may determine the manner and hours of work, subject to meeting the timelines and quality standards reasonably specified by AtliQ and attending agreed client and team meetings.

clauses.title: Term
clauses.text: This Agreement commences on 28 April 2025 and continues for twelve (12) months, until 27 April 2026, unless terminated earlier or extended in writing.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: AtliQ shall pay the Contractor the fees set out in the Engagement Schedule.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: The Contractor shall submit a monthly invoice, supported by a timesheet approved by the AtliQ project lead. AtliQ shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: AtliQ shall deduct tax at source under the Income Tax Act, 1961 as applicable and provide TDS certificates. The Contractor is responsible for his own GST registration (if required) and all other taxes.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: AtliQ shall reimburse reasonable pre-approved travel expenses incurred for client visits.

clauses.title: Independent contractor status
clauses.text: The Contractor is an independent contractor and not an employee, partner or agent of AtliQ. The Contractor is not entitled to salary, provident fund, gratuity, leave or other employee benefits.

clauses.title: Independent contractor status
clauses.text: The Contractor may provide services to other persons during the Term, provided this does not affect performance of the Services or breach Clause 6.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: In this Clause, "Work Product" means all dashboards, reports, data models, DAX measures, Power Query scripts, visual templates, documentation and other materials created by the Contractor in performing the Services.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: The Contractor retains ownership of all intellectual property rights in the Work Product and in any pre-existing materials, components and templates of the Contractor.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: The Contractor grants AtliQ a non-exclusive, perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, worldwide licence to use, copy, modify and deploy the Work Product for the purposes of AtliQ's business, including for delivery to AtliQ's clients.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: The Contractor shall not incorporate into the Work Product any third-party material that AtliQ is not entitled to use under Clause 5.3.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information of the other party, and in the case of AtliQ, of AtliQ's clients, received in connection with this Agreement, and shall use it only for the purposes of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: The Contractor shall comply with any confidentiality and data-security requirements of AtliQ's clients notified to him in writing, including restrictions on downloading client data to personal devices.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: This Clause 6 does not apply to information that is public, already lawfully known, independently developed, or required to be disclosed by law.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: The obligations in this Clause 6 survive for three (3) years after termination or expiry.

clauses.title: Warranties
clauses.text: The Contractor warrants that he has the skills and experience to perform the Services and will perform them with reasonable skill and care.

clauses.title: Warranties
clauses.text: The Contractor warrants that the Work Product will not, to his knowledge, infringe the intellectual property rights of any third party.

clauses.title: Liability
clauses.text: Each party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable to the Contractor in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, except for breach of Clause 6 or fraud.

clauses.title: Liability
clauses.text: Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving fifteen (15) days' written notice.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate immediately by written notice if the other commits a material breach not remedied within seven (7) days of notice.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: On termination, AtliQ shall pay for Services performed up to the termination date, and the Contractor shall hand over all Work Product in progress and return AtliQ and client materials.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: Clauses 5, 6, 8 and 10 survive termination or expiry.

clauses.title: General - Non-solicitation
clauses.text: Non-solicitation. During the Term and for six (6) months thereafter, the Contractor shall not directly solicit any AtliQ client to whom he was introduced through AtliQ for the purpose of providing the same Services to that client independently of AtliQ.

clauses.title: General - Assignment
clauses.text: Assignment. The Contractor may not assign this Agreement. AtliQ may assign it to an Affiliate on notice.

clauses.title: General - Entire agreement
clauses.text: Entire agreement. This Agreement, including the Engagement Schedule, is the entire agreement between the parties on its subject matter.

clauses.title: General - Governing law and jurisdiction
clauses.text: Governing law and jurisdiction. This Agreement is governed by the laws of India. The courts at Pune shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

clauses.title: General - Counterparts
clauses.text: Counterparts. This Agreement may be signed electronically.

This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is made and entered into at Pune on 18 April 2025 (the "Effective Date")
BETWEEN
SUNRISE FOODS PRIVATE LIMITED, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at Sunrise House, NH 66 Bypass, Edappally, Kochi 682024, Kerala, India ("Sunrise" or the "Client");
AND
ATLIQ TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456; GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3), having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("AtliQ" or the "Service Provider").

clauses.title: Recitals
clauses.text:
A. Sunrise manufactures and distributes packaged food products through a network of distributors across India and wishes to engage a technology partner to build and support digital tools for its distribution network.
B. AtliQ provides custom software development, data platform and analytics services.
C. The Parties intend that this Agreement shall govern all Statements of Work entered into between them during its term.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Business Day" means any day other than a Sunday or a public holiday in Kerala or Maharashtra.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Deliverables" means all software, code, designs, documentation and other outputs to be delivered under an SOW.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Monthly Support Fee" means the monthly fee for support and maintenance services specified in an SOW.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Service Levels" means the availability, response and resolution targets set out in Schedule A or the relevant SOW.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Service Credit" means a credit against the Monthly Support Fee calculated in accordance with Clause 8.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "SOW" means a statement of work executed by authorised signatories of both Parties that references this Agreement. SOW-1 (Distributor Portal v1) is executed concurrently with this Agreement.

clauses.title: Services
clauses.text: AtliQ shall provide the services described in each SOW (the "Services") in accordance with this Agreement.

clauses.title: Services
clauses.text: SOW-1 covers the design, development and deployment of a web-based distributor portal (order placement, invoice and ledger view, scheme and promotion visibility) ("Distributor Portal v1"), together with post-go-live support and maintenance for twelve (12) months.

clauses.title: Services - Sunrise's project owner shall be Ms
clauses.text: Sunrise's project owner shall be Ms. Meera Pillai. AtliQ's project owner shall be designated in each SOW.

clauses.title: Services
clauses.text: Each SOW shall be a separate contract incorporating the terms of this Agreement. In the event of conflict, this Agreement prevails unless the SOW expressly states otherwise.

clauses.title: Change management
clauses.text: Changes to scope, timelines or fees shall be agreed through a written change request signed by both Parties' project owners.

clauses.title: Obligations of sunrise
clauses.text: Sunrise shall provide timely access to its ERP (including test environments), master data, business users and approvals required for the Services.

clauses.title: Obligations of sunrise
clauses.text: Sunrise shall be responsible for the accuracy of data it provides.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: The total Fees under SOW-1 are USD 33,000 (United States Dollars Thirty-Three Thousand only), comprising build fees payable on Milestones and a Monthly Support Fee for the support period, as detailed in SOW-1.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: AtliQ shall invoice build fees upon completion of each Milestone and the Monthly Support Fee monthly in arrears. Sunrise shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: All amounts are exclusive of GST, which shall be charged additionally at the applicable rate. Sunrise may deduct TDS as required by law.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: Delayed payments shall attract interest at twelve percent (12%) per annum.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be valid for a period of three (3) years from the Effective Date, i.e., until 17 April 2028, and may be renewed by mutual written agreement.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Either Party may terminate this Agreement or any SOW for material breach not cured within thirty (30) days of written notice.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Sunrise may terminate any SOW for convenience by giving forty-five (45) days' written notice, subject to payment for all work performed up to the effective date of termination.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Expiry or termination of this Agreement shall not affect any SOW then in force, which shall continue to be governed by this Agreement until its completion.

clauses.title: Acceptance
clauses.text: Sunrise shall conduct user acceptance testing within ten (10) Business Days of each delivery. Deliverables shall be deemed accepted upon written sign-off, or if no material defects are reported within such period, or upon use in production.

clauses.title: Service levels and service credits
clauses.text: During the support period under any SOW, AtliQ shall meet the Service Levels set out in Schedule A.

clauses.title: Service levels and service credits
clauses.text: If AtliQ fails to meet a Service Level in any calendar month for reasons attributable to AtliQ, Sunrise shall be entitled to Service Credits as set out in Schedule A.

clauses.title: Service levels and service credits
clauses.text: The total Service Credits in any calendar month shall not exceed five percent (5%) of the Monthly Support Fee for that month.

clauses.title: Service levels and service credits
clauses.text: Service Credits shall be applied against the next invoice and shall be Sunrise's sole monetary remedy for failure to meet the Service Levels. Service Credits are a price adjustment reflecting the reduced value of the Services and are not a penalty.

clauses.title: Service levels and service credits
clauses.text: No Service Credit shall accrue for failures caused by Sunrise, its third-party vendors, scheduled maintenance notified in advance, or Force Majeure.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each Party shall treat the other Party's confidential information (including distributor lists, pricing, schemes and source code) as strictly confidential and use it only for performing this Agreement.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: This obligation shall survive for three (3) years after termination.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: Upon payment in full, Sunrise shall own all intellectual property rights in the Deliverables developed specifically for Sunrise under an SOW.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: AtliQ retains ownership of its pre-existing tools, components, libraries and know-how. AtliQ grants Sunrise a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to use any such pre-existing materials to the extent incorporated in the Deliverables.

clauses.title: Warranties
clauses.text: AtliQ warrants that the Services will be performed with due skill and care, and that Deliverables will materially conform to the specifications for ninety (90) days post go-live.

clauses.title: Indemnity
clauses.text: Each Party shall indemnify the other against third-party claims arising out of its breach of confidentiality, infringement of intellectual property rights, or gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Neither Party shall be liable for indirect, consequential or special losses or loss of profits.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Each Party's aggregate liability under an SOW shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable under that SOW.

clauses.title: Data protection
clauses.text: AtliQ shall comply with the Information Technology Act, 2000, the rules thereunder, and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 to the extent applicable, in relation to any personal data of distributors or employees processed in performing the Services.

clauses.title: Non-solicitation
clauses.text: Neither Party shall solicit the employees of the other Party engaged in the Services during the term of the relevant SOW and six (6) months thereafter.

clauses.title: Force majeure
clauses.text: Neither Party shall be liable for failure or delay due to causes beyond its reasonable control.

clauses.title: Governing law and arbitration
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India.

clauses.title: Governing law and arbitration
clauses.text: Any dispute not resolved amicably within thirty (30) days shall be referred to arbitration by a sole arbitrator appointed mutually under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The seat and venue of arbitration shall be Pune, Maharashtra, and the proceedings shall be in English.

clauses.title: Governing law and arbitration
clauses.text: The courts at Pune shall have exclusive jurisdiction, subject to Clause 17.2.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: Neither Party shall assign this Agreement without prior written consent of the other.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: This Agreement and its SOWs constitute the entire agreement. Amendments must be in writing and signed by both Parties.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: Notices shall be sent to the registered addresses above and by email to the project owners.

clauses.title: Service levels (support period)
clauses.text:
| Priority | Description | Response | Resolution | Service Credit per breach |
| P1 | Portal down / orders cannot be placed | 1 hour | 8 hours | 2% of Monthly Support Fee |
| P2 | Major function degraded | 4 hours | 2 Business Days | 1% of Monthly Support Fee |
| P3 | Minor issue / query | 1 Business Day | 5 Business Days | Nil |
Portal availability target: 99.0% per calendar month (excluding scheduled maintenance). Subject to the cap in Clause 8.3.

ACME RETAIL GROUP PRIVATE LIMITED, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having its registered office at No. 45, Anna Salai, Teynampet, Chennai 600018, Tamil Nadu, India (hereinafter referred to as the "Client", which expression shall, unless repugnant to the context, include its successors and permitted assigns) of the ONE PART;

clauses.title: Recitals
clauses.text:
WHEREAS the Client operates a chain of retail stores in South India and wishes to implement enterprise Power BI dashboards for sales, inventory and store performance reporting;
WHEREAS the Service Provider is engaged in the business of software development, data analytics and business intelligence services; and
WHEREAS the Parties wish to record the terms on which the Service Provider will render such services.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Deliverables" means the dashboards, data models, reports, documentation and other work product specified in a Statement of Work.

clauses.title: Definitions

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Milestone" and "Milestone Fee" mean a milestone and the fee attributable to it, as specified in a Statement of Work.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Statement of Work" or "SOW" means a document executed by both Parties describing specific services, Deliverables, Milestones and Fees.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Confidential Information" means all business, technical, financial and customer information disclosed by either Party, whether oral, written or electronic, that is designated as confidential or ought reasonably to be understood as confidential.

clauses.title: Scope of services
clauses.text: The Service Provider shall provide the services described in each SOW ("Services"). SOW-1 dated 10 March 2025 covers the design and implementation of Power BI dashboards for sales, inventory and store performance across the Client's retail network.

clauses.title: Scope of services
clauses.text: Any change in scope shall be effected only through a written change request signed by both Parties.

clauses.title: Scope of services
clauses.text: The Client's single point of contact shall be Ms. Priya Raman.

clauses.title: Client obligations
clauses.text: The Client shall provide timely access to its ERP and point-of-sale data, Power BI tenant, and relevant personnel, and shall review and respond to Deliverables within the timelines in the SOW.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: The total Fees under SOW-1 are USD 38,000 (United States Dollars Thirty-Eight Thousand only), payable against Milestones as specified in SOW-1.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: The Service Provider shall raise invoices upon completion of each Milestone. The Client shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: Fees are exclusive of Goods and Services Tax ("GST"), which shall be charged at the applicable rate. The Client may deduct tax at source as required under the Income Tax Act, 1961 and shall furnish TDS certificates within the statutory timelines.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and remain in force for a period of two (2) years, unless terminated earlier.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Either Party may terminate this Agreement upon thirty (30) days' written notice if the other Party commits a material breach and fails to cure it within such period.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: The Client may terminate an SOW for convenience upon thirty (30) days' written notice, subject to payment for Services rendered and Milestones completed or in progress (pro rata) up to the date of termination.

clauses.title: Acceptance
clauses.text: The Client shall test each Deliverable within seven (7) business days of delivery. A Deliverable shall be deemed accepted if no written notice of material non-conformity is received within that period.

clauses.title: Delay and liquidated damages
clauses.text: If the Service Provider fails to complete a Milestone by the agreed date for reasons solely attributable to the Service Provider, the Service Provider shall pay liquidated damages at the rate of 0.5% (half percent) of the Milestone Fee of the delayed Milestone for each complete week of delay.

clauses.title: Delay and liquidated damages
clauses.text: The aggregate liquidated damages in respect of any Milestone shall not exceed 5% (five percent) of the Milestone Fee of that Milestone.

clauses.title: Delay and liquidated damages
clauses.text: No liquidated damages shall be payable where the delay is caused by the Client, including delayed access to data or systems, delayed review of Deliverables, or changes in scope, or by a Force Majeure event.

clauses.title: Delay and liquidated damages
clauses.text: The Parties agree that the liquidated damages are a genuine pre-estimate of loss and shall be the Client's sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each Party shall maintain the other Party's Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall not disclose it to any third party except to its employees and professional advisers on a need-to-know basis.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: These obligations shall survive for three (3) years after termination of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: Upon receipt of full payment, all intellectual property rights in the Deliverables created specifically for the Client shall vest in the Client.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: The Service Provider shall retain all rights in its pre-existing intellectual property, tools, templates and know-how, and grants the Client a non-exclusive, perpetual, royalty-free licence to use any such pre-existing materials incorporated into the Deliverables for the Client's internal business purposes.

clauses.title: Warranties
clauses.text: The Service Provider warrants that the Services will be performed in a professional manner by qualified personnel, and that the Deliverables shall conform materially to the SOW for sixty (60) days from acceptance.

clauses.title: Indemnity
clauses.text: Each Party ("Indemnifying Party") shall indemnify the other against losses arising from third-party claims caused by the Indemnifying Party's breach of confidentiality, infringement of third-party intellectual property rights, or gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Neither Party shall be liable for any indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages, including loss of profits or business.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: The total aggregate liability of either Party under this Agreement shall not exceed the total Fees paid or payable under the SOW giving rise to the claim.

clauses.title: Data protection
clauses.text: The Service Provider shall process personal data received from the Client only for the purpose of the Services and in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the rules made thereunder, as and when in force, and shall implement reasonable security practices.

clauses.title: Non-solicitation
clauses.text: During the term and for six (6) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit any employee of the other Party who was involved in the Services.

clauses.title: Force majeure
clauses.text: Neither Party shall be liable for any delay or failure in performance caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including acts of God, epidemics, war, strikes or governmental action.

clauses.title: Governing law and dispute resolution
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India.

clauses.text:
This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is made on the date stated above between:
1. AL NOOR HOSPITALITY GROUP LLC, a limited liability company registered in the Emirate of Dubai, United Arab Emirates, having its principal office at Level 22, Al Noor Tower, Sheikh Zayed Road, PO Box 118834, Dubai, United Arab Emirates (the "Client"); and
2. ATLIQ TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED, a private limited company incorporated under the laws of India (CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456; GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3), having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India (the "Supplier"),
each a "Party" and together the "Parties".

clauses.title: Recitals
clauses.text:
A. The Client owns, operates and manages a portfolio of hotels, resorts and serviced apartments in the United Arab Emirates and wishes to implement a centralised guest analytics platform across fourteen (14) of its properties.
B. The Supplier is engaged in the business of providing software development, data engineering, analytics and artificial intelligence services and has represented that it has the skills and resources to deliver such platform.
C. The Parties wish to set out the terms on which the Supplier will provide the Services to the Client, including certain restrictions reasonably necessary to protect the Client's commercially sensitive information and competitive position.
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants set out below, the Parties agree as follows:

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: In this Agreement, unless the context otherwise requires, capitalised terms have the meanings given below.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Affiliate" means, in relation to a Party, any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with that Party, where "control" means the ownership of more than fifty percent (50%) of the voting securities of an entity or the power to direct its management and policies, whether by contract or otherwise.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Business Day" means a day other than a Friday, Saturday or public holiday in Dubai.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Client Data" means all data, including Guest Data, reservation, occupancy, pricing and revenue data, supplied by or on behalf of the Client or generated by the Platform in the course of the Services.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Confidential Information" has the meaning given in Clause 8.1.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Deliverables" means all documents, software, dashboards, models, reports and other materials delivered by the Supplier to the Client under an SOW.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Effective Date" means 15 March 2025.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Fees" means the fees payable by the Client for the Services as set out in Clause 5 and the applicable SOW.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "GCC" means the member states of the Gulf Cooperation Council, being the United Arab Emirates, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the State of Qatar, the State of Kuwait, the Kingdom of Bahrain and the Sultanate of Oman.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Guest Data" means any personal data relating to guests, prospective guests or loyalty members of the Client.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Hospitality Business" means any person, firm or entity that owns, operates, manages or franchises hotels, resorts or serviced apartments, or that provides distribution, revenue-management or guest-analytics services to any such person, firm or entity.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Milestone" means a delivery milestone specified in an SOW.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Platform" means the guest analytics platform to be designed, built and deployed by the Supplier for the Client as described in SOW-1.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Restricted Period" means the Term and the period of eighteen (18) months following the expiry or termination of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "Services" means the services described in this Agreement and each SOW.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation
clauses.text: "SOW" means a statement of work executed by both Parties referencing this Agreement.

clauses.title: Definitions and interpretation - Clause headings are for convenience only
clauses.text: Clause headings are for convenience only. References to "including" mean "including without limitation". The singular includes the plural and vice versa.

clauses.title: Appointment and scope
clauses.text: The Client appoints the Supplier to provide the Services, and the Supplier agrees to provide the Services, on the terms of this Agreement and each SOW.

clauses.title: Appointment and scope
clauses.text: The initial SOW ("SOW-1") is attached as Schedule 1 and covers the design, build, deployment and hypercare of the Platform across the fourteen (14) properties listed in Schedule 1, including integration with the Client's property management system, central reservation system and loyalty database, guest segmentation models, and executive dashboards.

clauses.title: Appointment and scope
clauses.text: In the event of a conflict between this Agreement and an SOW, this Agreement shall prevail unless the SOW expressly states that it overrides a specified clause of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Change control
clauses.text: Either Party may request a change to an SOW by written change request. No change shall be binding unless agreed in a written change order signed by authorised representatives of both Parties.

clauses.title: Change control
clauses.text: The Supplier shall, within ten (10) Business Days of a change request, provide an impact assessment covering effort, timeline and Fees.

clauses.title: Client obligations
clauses.text: The Client shall provide the Supplier with timely access to its systems, data, premises and personnel as reasonably required, and shall nominate a single point of contact, who shall initially be Mr. Omar Haddad, Head of Digital.

clauses.title: Client obligations
clauses.text: The Client shall be responsible for obtaining any third-party consents required for the Supplier to access the Client's systems.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: The total Fees for SOW-1 are USD 185,000 (one hundred and eighty-five thousand United States Dollars), payable against Milestones as set out in Schedule 1.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: The Supplier shall invoice upon achievement of each Milestone. Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of receipt.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: All Fees are exclusive of VAT and any other applicable taxes. Where the Client is required by law to withhold tax, it shall provide the Supplier with the relevant withholding certificate.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: Late payments shall bear interest at one percent (1%) per month from the due date until the date of payment.

clauses.title: Fees and payment
clauses.text: The Client may dispute any invoice in good faith by written notice within ten (10) Business Days of receipt, and shall pay the undisputed portion by the due date.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for a period of three (3) years, expiring on 14 March 2028 (the "Term"), unless terminated earlier in accordance with this Clause 6.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Either Party may terminate this Agreement by written notice with immediate effect if the other Party commits a material breach which, if remediable, is not remedied within thirty (30) days of written notice.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Either Party may terminate this Agreement immediately if the other Party becomes insolvent, enters into liquidation or has a receiver appointed.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: The Client may terminate an SOW for convenience on sixty (60) days' written notice, subject to payment for all Services performed up to the date of termination and any non-cancellable costs.

clauses.title: Term and termination
clauses.text: Clauses 8, 9, 12, 14, 15, 16 and 21 shall survive expiry or termination of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Personnel
clauses.text: The Supplier shall assign suitably qualified personnel and shall not replace key personnel named in an SOW without the Client's prior consent, not to be unreasonably withheld.

clauses.title: Personnel
clauses.text: Supplier personnel attending the Client's premises shall comply with the Client's site, health and safety and information security policies.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: "Confidential Information" means all information disclosed by one Party to the other, whether before or after the Effective Date, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be regarded as confidential, including Client Data, pricing strategies, rate plans, occupancy forecasts and business plans.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each Party shall keep the other's Confidential Information confidential, use it only for the purposes of this Agreement, and disclose it only to its employees and advisers who need to know it and are bound by equivalent obligations.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: These obligations do not apply to information that is public other than through breach, was lawfully known before disclosure, is independently developed, or is required to be disclosed by law.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: The obligations in this Clause 8 continue for five (5) years after expiry or termination.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: Upon payment in full of the relevant Fees, all intellectual property rights in the Deliverables created specifically for the Client shall vest in the Client.

clauses.title: Intellectual property
clauses.text: The Supplier retains ownership of its pre-existing tools, libraries, methodologies and know-how ("Supplier Background IP"). To the extent any Supplier Background IP is incorporated into a Deliverable, the Supplier grants the Client a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to use it as part of that Deliverable.

clauses.title: Delivery, acceptance and liquidated damages
clauses.text: The Supplier shall use all reasonable endeavours to achieve each Milestone by the date set out in the relevant SOW.

clauses.title: Delivery, acceptance and liquidated damages
clauses.text: Each Deliverable shall be subject to acceptance testing by the Client within ten (10) Business Days of delivery against the acceptance criteria in the SOW. Deliverables not rejected in writing within that period shall be deemed accepted.

clauses.title: Delivery, acceptance and liquidated damages
clauses.text: If the Supplier fails to achieve a Milestone by its due date for reasons attributable to the Supplier, the Supplier shall pay to the Client, as liquidated damages, one percent (1%) of the Fees payable for the affected Milestone for each complete week of delay, provided that the aggregate liquidated damages payable under this Agreement shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the total Fees payable under this Agreement.

clauses.title: Delivery, acceptance and liquidated damages
clauses.text: The Parties agree that the liquidated damages in Clause 10.3 are a genuine pre-estimate of loss. No liquidated damages shall be payable for delay caused by the Client, its contractors, or a Force Majeure Event.

clauses.title: Warranties
clauses.text: The Supplier warrants that the Services will be performed with reasonable skill and care in accordance with good industry practice, and that the Deliverables will materially conform to their specifications for ninety (90) days after acceptance.

clauses.title: Warranties
clauses.text: Each Party warrants that it has full power and authority to enter into this Agreement.

clauses.title: Warranties
clauses.text: Except as expressly set out in this Agreement, all other warranties are excluded to the extent permitted by law.

clauses.title: Restrictive covenants
clauses.text: In consideration of the Client disclosing to the Supplier its Confidential Information, including its revenue strategies, pricing models and Guest Data, the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.

clauses.title: Restrictive covenants
clauses.text: For the purposes of Clause 12.1, services are provided "in the GCC" if the Hospitality Business receiving them is headquartered in, or the services relate to properties or operations located in, any state of the GCC, irrespective of where the services are performed.

clauses.title: Restrictive covenants
clauses.text: The Supplier shall procure that each of its Affiliates complies with this Clause 12 as if it were a party to this Agreement, and any breach by an Affiliate shall be deemed a breach by the Supplier.

clauses.title: Restrictive covenants
clauses.text: The Client may, in its sole discretion, waive the restriction in Clause 12.1 in respect of a specific engagement by written consent signed by an authorised signatory of the Client. Any such waiver shall be limited to its express terms.

clauses.title: Restrictive covenants
clauses.text: During the Term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other Party who was directly involved in the Services, save through general advertisements not targeted at such employees.

clauses.title: Restrictive covenants
clauses.text: The Supplier acknowledges that the restrictions in this Clause 12 are reasonable in scope, duration and geography and are necessary to protect the legitimate interests of the Client.

clauses.title: Subcontracting
clauses.text: The Supplier shall not subcontract any part of the Services without the Client's prior written consent. The Supplier remains responsible for the acts and omissions of its subcontractors.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Neither Party shall be liable for any indirect, consequential or special loss, or for loss of profits, revenue, goodwill or anticipated savings.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Subject to Clause 14.3, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed an amount equal to the Fees paid by the Client to the Supplier in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

clauses.title: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: Nothing in this Agreement limits liability for fraud, wilful misconduct, breach of Clause 8 (Confidentiality), or death or personal injury caused by negligence.

clauses.title: Indemnity
clauses.text: The Supplier shall indemnify the Client against losses arising from any third-party claim that the Deliverables (excluding Client materials) infringe that third party's intellectual property rights.

clauses.title: Indemnity
clauses.text: The Client shall indemnify the Supplier against losses arising from any third-party claim that Client Data or Client materials infringe that third party's rights.

clauses.title: Indemnity
clauses.text: The indemnified Party shall promptly notify the indemnifying Party, allow it conduct of the defence, and provide reasonable assistance.

clauses.title: Data protection
clauses.text: Each Party shall comply with applicable data protection laws, including the DIFC Data Protection Law No. 5 of 2020 and the UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021, to the extent applicable.

clauses.title: Data protection
clauses.text: The Supplier shall process Guest Data only on the documented instructions of the Client, implement appropriate technical and organisational measures, and notify the Client without undue delay (and in any event within forty-eight (48) hours) of any personal data breach.

clauses.title: Data protection
clauses.text: The Supplier shall not transfer Guest Data outside the UAE without the Client's prior written consent. Any Guest Data accessed from India shall be accessed remotely from UAE-hosted environments only.

clauses.title: Insurance
clauses.text: The Supplier shall maintain professional indemnity insurance of not less than USD 500,000 per claim for the Term and one (1) year thereafter.

clauses.title: Force majeure
clauses.text: Neither Party shall be liable for delay or failure caused by events beyond its reasonable control (a "Force Majeure Event"), provided it notifies the other Party promptly. If a Force Majeure Event continues for more than sixty (60) days, either Party may terminate the affected SOW.

clauses.title: Assignment
clauses.text: Neither Party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other, except that the Client may assign to an Affiliate on written notice.

clauses.title: Notices
clauses.text: Notices shall be in writing and delivered by hand, courier or email to: (a) Client: Attn. Head of Digital, Level 22, Al Noor Tower, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, with copy to legal@alnoorhospitality.ae; (b) Supplier: Attn. Chief Executive Officer, 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, India, with copy to karandeep@atliq.com.

clauses.title: Governing law and dispute resolution
clauses.text: This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising out of it shall be governed by the laws of the Dubai International Financial Centre.

clauses.title: Governing law and dispute resolution
clauses.text: The Parties shall first attempt to resolve any dispute through good-faith negotiation between senior executives for thirty (30) days.

clauses.title: Governing law and dispute resolution
clauses.text: Failing resolution, the courts of the Dubai International Financial Centre shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: This Agreement, together with its Schedules and SOWs, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes all prior discussions.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: No amendment shall be effective unless in writing and signed by both Parties. No failure or delay in exercising any right shall operate as a waiver.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: If any provision is held invalid, the remainder shall continue in effect, and the invalid provision shall be deemed modified to the minimum extent necessary to make it enforceable.

clauses.title: General - The Parties are independent contractors
clauses.text: The Parties are independent contractors. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature.

findings.clauseTitle: Delivery, acceptance and liquidated damages - delay damages
findings.whyItMatters: Karandeep's checklist: 'LDs → cap it. never open ended.' AtliQ's standard (Acme, Northwind, Trustline) is 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week, capped at 5% of that milestone, with no LDs for client-caused delay. The 10% cap matches Al Noor's, which Karandeep approved as 'a strategic exception for Al Noor only, not our new standard'.

citation.quote: If the Supplier fails to achieve a Milestone by its due date for reasons attributable to the Supplier, the Supplier shall pay to the Client, as liquidated damages, one percent (1%) of the Fees payable for the affected Milestone for each complete week of delay, provided that the aggregate liquidated damages payable under this Agreement shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the total Fees payable under this Agreement.

clauses.title: Parties

This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (the "Agreement") is made between:
1. AL NOOR HOSPITALITY GROUP LLC, a limited liability company registered in the Emirate of Dubai, United Arab Emirates, having its principal office at Level 22, Al Noor Tower, Sheikh Zayed Road, PO Box 118834, Dubai, United Arab Emirates ("Al Noor"); and
2. ATLIQ TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED, a private limited company incorporated under the laws of India (CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456; GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3), having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("AtliQ"),
each a "Party" and together the "Parties".

clauses.title: Recitals
clauses.text:
A. The Parties are discussing a possible engagement under which AtliQ would design and implement a guest analytics platform for Al Noor's hotel portfolio (the "Purpose").
B. In the course of those discussions each Party expects to disclose to the other certain confidential information, and each Party wishes to protect its information on equal terms.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Confidential Information" means any information disclosed by one Party (the "Disclosing Party") to the other Party (the "Receiving Party") in connection with the Purpose, whether before or after the date of this Agreement, in any form, that is marked or identified as confidential or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential, including guest and occupancy data, pricing, commercial proposals, solution architecture, source code, methodologies and business plans.

clauses.title: Definitions
clauses.text: "Representatives" means a Party's directors, officers, employees, professional advisers and subcontractors who need to know the Confidential Information for the Purpose.

clauses.title: Obligations of the receiving party
Obligations of the receiving party
clauses.text: Each Party is responsible for any breach of this Agreement by its Representatives.

clauses.title: Exclusions
Exclusions
clauses.text: A Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information where required by law, regulation or order of a competent court or authority, provided that (where lawful) it gives the Disclosing Party prompt prior notice and discloses only the minimum required.

clauses.title: Personal data
clauses.text: Where Confidential Information includes personal data of guests or employees, the Receiving Party shall process it only as necessary for the Purpose and in accordance with applicable data protection law, including the UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 and the Indian Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, as applicable.

clauses.title: Return and destruction
clauses.text: On written request of the Disclosing Party, or on termination of discussions, the Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information, save for copies retained in routine electronic back-ups or as required by law, which remain subject to this Agreement.

clauses.title: Term
clauses.text: This Agreement applies to disclosures made during the period of two (2) years from its date. Either Party may end that period earlier by thirty (30) days' written notice.

clauses.title: Term
clauses.text: The obligations in Clauses 2 to 5 shall continue for five (5) years from the date of each disclosure.

clauses.title: No licence; no obligation
clauses.text: All Confidential Information remains the property of the Disclosing Party. No licence or other right is granted except as expressly stated.

clauses.title: No licence; no obligation
clauses.text: Nothing in this Agreement obliges either Party to enter into any further agreement or transaction.

clauses.title: Remedies
clauses.text: Each Party acknowledges that damages may not be an adequate remedy for breach, and that the Disclosing Party may seek injunctive or equitable relief in addition to any other remedy.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: This Agreement is the entire agreement between the Parties on its subject matter and may be amended only in writing signed by both Parties.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: Neither Party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of India. Any dispute shall be referred to arbitration by a sole arbitrator under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, seated in Mumbai, conducted in English.

clauses.title: General
clauses.text: This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature.

findings.clauseTitle: Data security - no data access from outside the US
findings.whyItMatters: AtliQ Inc delivers through the Pune team (intercompany agreement). A US-only rule, including remote access, means the delivery model has to change before signing. CareBridge allowed de-identified data offshore; this may not.

citation.quote: Supplier shall not access Crestline production data from outside the United States without Crestline's prior written approval.

precedents.outcome: Counsel review ($3,800); per-engagement intercompany BAA; only de-identified data offshore
precedents.label: standard

findings.clauseTitle: Rates - rates locked for 12 months
findings.whyItMatters: Today's rate card can't move for two years and applies to all future SOWs, so any discount given now is locked in (and visible to Crestline's pricing audit).

citation.quote: The Rate Card rates are fixed for the first twelve (12) months of the Term.

precedents.outcome: Accepted as drafted: 'We never discount, so it's harmless.'
precedents.label: exception
